/**
 * database.js
 * المخطط الشامل لقاعدة بيانات Gherbi.Ai POS (46 جدولاً، فهارس الأداء، مشغلات المزامنة والمخزون،
 * القاموس الجزائري لباركود 613، نظام البيع بالتقسيط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير)
 */

'use strict';

const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { attachWriteQueue } = require('./db-write-queue');
const { installSoftDeleteShim } = require('./soft-delete');
const { installDataRevisionHook, tracker: dataRevisionTracker } = require('./data-revision');

function resolveDatabaseFilePath() {
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      const dir = app.getPath('userData');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      return path.join(dir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  if (!fs.existsSync(fallbackDir)) fs.mkdirSync(fallbackDir, { recursive: true });
  return path.join(fallbackDir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
}

const dbPath = resolveDatabaseFilePath();
const db = new sqlite3.Database(dbPath);
/* [V43_PRE_QUEUE_NATIVE_NAPI_SHIELD] */
(function installPreQueueNativeNapiShield(database) {
  database._isEnvironmentClosing = false;
  database._activeNativeOps = 0;

  const rawRun = database.run.bind(database);
  const rawGet = database.get.bind(database);
  const rawAll = database.all.bind(database);
  const rawExec = database.exec.bind(database);
  const rawPrepare = database.prepare.bind(database);
  const rawClose = database.close.bind(database);

  function wrapCallback(cb, defaultResult) {
    if (typeof cb !== 'function') return null;
    let called = false;
    return function (err, res) {
      if (!called) {
        called = true;
        database._activeNativeOps = Math.max(0, database._activeNativeOps - 1);
      }
      if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) return;
      try {
        cb.call(this, err, res !== undefined ? res : defaultResult);
      } catch (_) {}
    };
  }

  function makeSafeMethod(origFn, defaultRes) {
    return function (sql, params, callback) {
      if (typeof params === 'function') {
        callback = params;
        params = [];
      }
      if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) {
        if (typeof callback === 'function') {
          setImmediate(() => {
            try { callback.call({ lastID: 0, changes: 0 }, null, defaultRes); } catch (_) {}
          });
        }
        return this;
      }
      database._activeNativeOps++;
      const safeCb = wrapCallback(callback, defaultRes) || function () {
        database._activeNativeOps = Math.max(0, database._activeNativeOps - 1);
      };
      try {
        if (params !== undefined) {
          return origFn(sql, params, safeCb);
        }
        return origFn(sql, safeCb);
      } catch (e) {
        database._activeNativeOps = Math.max(0, database._activeNativeOps - 1);
        if (typeof callback === 'function' && !database._isEnvironmentClosing) {
          setImmediate(() => { try { callback(e); } catch (_) {} });
        }
        return this;
      }
    };
  }

  database.run = makeSafeMethod(rawRun, undefined);
  database.get = makeSafeMethod(rawGet, undefined);
  database.all = makeSafeMethod(rawAll, []);
  database.exec = function (sql, callback) {
    if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) {
      if (typeof callback === 'function') setImmediate(() => { try { callback(null); } catch (_) {} });
      return this;
    }
    database._activeNativeOps++;
    const safeCb = wrapCallback(callback, undefined) || function () {
      database._activeNativeOps = Math.max(0, database._activeNativeOps - 1);
    };
    try {
      return rawExec(sql, safeCb);
    } catch (e) {
      database._activeNativeOps = Math.max(0, database._activeNativeOps - 1);
      return this;
    }
  };

  database.prepare = function (sql, params, callback) {
    if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) {
      return {
        run: function () { return this; },
        get: function () { return this; },
        all: function () { return this; },
        finalize: function (cb) { if (typeof cb === 'function') cb(); return this; }
      };
    }
    try {
      const stmt = rawPrepare(sql);
      const origStmtRun = stmt.run.bind(stmt);
      const origStmtFinalize = stmt.finalize.bind(stmt);
      stmt.run = function (...sArgs) {
        if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) return this;
        try { return origStmtRun(...sArgs); } catch (_) { return this; }
      };
      stmt.finalize = function (cb) {
        if (database._isEnvironmentClosing) {
          if (typeof cb === 'function') setImmediate(() => { try { cb(); } catch (_) {} });
          return this;
        }
        try { return origStmtFinalize(cb); } catch (_) { return this; }
      };
      return stmt;
    } catch (_) {
      return {
        run: function () { return this; },
        finalize: function (cb) { if (typeof cb === 'function') cb(); return this; }
      };
    }
  };

  database.safeShutdownAndExit = function (exitCode = 0) {
    if (database._shutdownInitiated) return;
    database._shutdownInitiated = true;

    // 1. تفريغ سريع لملف WAL بينما القاعدة لا تزال مفتوحة وبيئة V8 حية
    try {
      rawRun('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)', [], () => {
        database._isEnvironmentClosing = true;
        rawClose(() => {
          try { process.kill(process.pid); } catch (_) { process.exit(exitCode); }
        });
      });
    } catch (_) {
      database._isEnvironmentClosing = true;
      try { process.kill(process.pid); } catch (_) { process.exit(exitCode); }
    }

    // صمام أمان زمني (220ms) يضمن الإنهاء المباشر قبل دخول FreeEnvironment
    setTimeout(() => {
      database._isEnvironmentClosing = true;
      try { process.kill(process.pid); } catch (_) { process.exit(exitCode); }
    }, 220);
  };

  process.on('SIGINT', () => database.safeShutdownAndExit(0));
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => database.safeShutdownAndExit(0));
})(db);

attachWriteQueue(db);
installSoftDeleteShim(db);
installDataRevisionHook(db);

function safeAddColumn(table, columnDef) {
  db._rawRun(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${columnDef}`, () => {});
}

function createSyncTriggersForTable(table) {
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert`);
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update`);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.uuid IS NULL OR NEW.uuid = '' OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at = ''
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.updated_at, ''), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
        origin_device = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.origin_device, ''), (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id')),
        dirty = COALESCE(${table}.dirty, 1)
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND NEW.server_rev IS OLD.server_rev
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        origin_device = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), ${table}.origin_device),
        dirty = 1
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);
}

function createStockLedgerTriggers() {
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert');
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update');

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id;

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        ib.uuid,
        p.uuid,
        pv.uuid,
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
      LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
      WHERE ib.id = NEW.id AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> '';
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update
    AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND ABS(COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0)) > 0.000001
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '');

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      WHERE COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0) <> 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm
          WHERE sm.batch_uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id))
        );

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'auto',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      );
    END;
  `);
}

function tombstoneOrphans() {
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const childTables = [
    'inventory_batches',
    'product_barcodes',
    'product_prices',
    'product_promotions',
    'product_option_groups',
    'product_variants',
    'bom_recipes'
  ];

  for (const tbl of childTables) {
    db._rawRun(
      `UPDATE ${tbl}
       SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?, dirty = 1
       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)`,
      [nowStr, nowStr]
    );
  }
}

function initializeDatabase() {
  db.serialize(() => {
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
    db._rawGet('PRAGMA quick_check', () => {});
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA cache_size = -32000');

    // 1. الإعدادات، معلومات المتجر، والمستخدمين
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )
    `);

    const setStmt = db._rawPrepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)');
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)) {
      setStmt.run(k, String(v));
    }
    setStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_info (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        address TEXT,
        phone TEXT,
        fax TEXT,
        email TEXT,
        rc TEXT,
        nif TEXT,
        ai TEXT,
        nis TEXT,
        logo TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT DEFAULT 'Cashier',
        permissions_json TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'Active',
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    // 2. المنتجات، الباركودات، مستويات الأسعار، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT,
        family TEXT,
        supplier TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        min_stock INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
        image TEXT,
        unit TEXT DEFAULT 'قطعة',
        color TEXT,
        weight_volume TEXT,
        wholesale_unit TEXT,
        wholesale_qty INTEGER,
        plu_code TEXT,
        has_variants INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_featured INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        material_role TEXT,
        track_serial INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        hide_from_pos INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);
    safeAddColumn('products', 'warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0');

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_barcodes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        price_label TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_prices (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        label TEXT NOT NULL,
        price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_option_groups (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`

/**
 * شحن تلقائي كامل لملف Lumina_DZ_Products.csv (31,533 منتجاً) في جدول dz_product_dictionary
 */
function autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary() {
  db._dzCsvSeededOrRunning = true;
  db._rawGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dz_product_dictionary', [], (err, row) => {
    if (db._isEnvironmentClosing || err || (row && Number(row.cnt) >= 1000)) return;
    const candidates = [
      path.join(__dirname, 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv')
    ];
    const csvPath = candidates.find((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
    if (!csvPath) return;

    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(csvPath, 'utf8');
      const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
      if (lines.length <= 1 || db._isEnvironmentClosing) return;

      db.serialize(() => {
        if (db._isEnvironmentClosing) return;
        db._rawRun('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION');
        const stmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
          if (db._isEnvironmentClosing) break;
          const line = lines[i];
          if (!line || !line.trim()) continue;
          const parts = line.split(',');
          const barcode = String(parts[0] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const name = String(parts[1] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          if (!barcode || !name || barcode.length < 6) continue;
          const category = String(parts[2] || 'عام').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim() || 'عام';
          const brand = String(parts[3] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const price = parseFloat(parts[4]) || 0;
          stmt.run(barcode, name.slice(0, 120), category.slice(0, 60), brand.slice(0, 60), 'قطعة', price);
        }
        stmt.finalize();
        db._rawRun('COMMIT');
      });
    } catch (e) {
      try { db._rawRun('ROLLBACK'); } catch (_) {}
    }
  });
}
autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary();

==================== FILE: db-write-queue.js (13.0 KB) ====================
'use strict';

let activeQueueInstance = null;

function isBenignTxError(err) {
  if (!err) return false;
  const msg = String(err.message || '');
  return (
    msg.includes('no such savepoint') ||
    msg.includes('cannot start a transaction within a transaction') ||
    msg.includes('cannot commit - no transaction is active') ||
    msg.includes('cannot rollback - no transaction is active')
  );
}

function normalizeArgs(params, callback) {
  if (typeof params === 'function') {
    return { params: [], callback: params };
  }
  return {
    params: params === undefined || params === null ? [] : params,
    callback: typeof callback === 'function' ? callback : null
  };
}

class DbWriteQueue {
  constructor(dbGetter) {
    this.getDb = typeof dbGetter === 'function' ? dbGetter : () => dbGetter;
    this.chain = Promise.resolve();
    this.txDepth = 0;
    this.spCounter = 0;
    this.stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      failed: 0,
      totalTimeMs: 0,
      maxTimeMs: 0,
      lastError: null
    };
  }


  getStats() {
    const s = this.stats || { enqueued: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, totalTimeMs: 0, maxTimeMs: 0, lastError: null };
    const avgMs = s.completed > 0 ? Number((s.totalTimeMs / s.completed).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    return {
      enqueued: s.enqueued,
      completed: s.completed,
      failed: s.failed,
      pending: Math.max(0, s.enqueued - s.completed - s.failed),
      queueDepth: Math.max(0, s.enqueued - s.completed - s.failed),
      txDepth: this.txDepth || 0,
      avgDurationMs: avgMs,
      avgWriteMs: avgMs,
      maxDurationMs: s.maxTimeMs || 0,
      lastError: s.lastError || null
    };
  }

  resetStats() {
    this.stats = { enqueued: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, totalTimeMs: 0, maxTimeMs: 0, lastError: null };
    return this.getStats();
  }

  get db() {
    return this.getDb();
  }

  enqueue(taskFn) {
    if (this.txDepth > 0) {
      return Promise.resolve().then(() => taskFn());
    }
    const next = this.chain.then(() => taskFn());
    this.chain = next.catch(() => {});
    return next;
  }

  runAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const runner = database._rawRun || database.run.bind(database);

      runner(sql, norm.params, function onRunComplete(err) {
        if (err && !isBenignTxError(err)) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback.call(this, err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        const resObj = {
          lastID: this && this.lastID !== undefined ? this.lastID : 0,
          changes: this && this.changes !== undefined ? this.changes : 0
        };
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback.call(resObj, null, resObj);
        resolve(resObj);
      });
    });
  }

  getAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const getter = database._rawGet || database.get.bind(database);

      getter(sql, norm.params, (err, row) => {
        if (err) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback(null, row);
        resolve(row);
      });
    });
  }

  allAsync(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    const norm = normalizeArgs(params, callback);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const aller = database._rawAll || database.all.bind(database);

      aller(sql, norm.params, (err, rows) => {
        if (err) {
          if (norm.callback) norm.callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        const safeRows = rows || [];
        if (norm.callback) norm.callback(null, safeRows);
        resolve(safeRows);
      });
    });
  }

  execAsync(sql, callback = null) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const database = this.db;
      if (!database) return reject(new Error('Database instance is not initialized'));
      const execer = database._rawExec || database.exec.bind(database);

      execer(sql, (err) => {
        if (err && !isBenignTxError(err)) {
          if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(err);
          return reject(err);
        }
        if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null);
        resolve();
      });
    });
  }

  dbRun(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.runAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbGet(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.getAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbAll(sql, params = [], callback = null) {
    return this.allAsync(sql, params, callback);
  }

  dbExec(sql, callback = null) {
    return this.execAsync(sql, callback);
  }

  // توليد الرقم التسلسلي التالي للفواتير والمستندات (db.nextNumber) المتوافق مع server.js
  async nextNumber(key = 'default', startAt = 1, callback = null) {
    if (typeof startAt === 'function') {
      callback = startAt;
      startAt = 1;
    }
    const cleanKey = String(key || 'default').trim();
    const settingKey = `seq_${cleanKey}`;

    try {
      // 1. محاولة القراءة من جدول counters أو sequences إن كان موجوداً في قاعدة البيانات
      let storedSeq = 0;
      const counterRow = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key IN (?, ?)',
        [settingKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => null);

      if (counterRow && counterRow.value !== undefined) {
        const parsed = parseInt(String(counterRow.value), 10);
        if (!isNaN(parsed)) storedSeq = parsed;
      }

      // فحص جدول counters المخصص إن وجد
      const dedicatedCounter = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT seq, value, current_value FROM counters WHERE name = ? OR key = ?',
        [cleanKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => null);
      if (dedicatedCounter) {
        const cVal = parseInt(dedicatedCounter.seq ?? dedicatedCounter.value ?? dedicatedCounter.current_value ?? 0, 10);
        if (!isNaN(cVal)) storedSeq = Math.max(storedSeq, cVal);
      }

      // 2. فحص أعلى رقم فاتورة في جدول sales لضمان عدم تكرار أي رقم فاتورة موجود مسبقاً
      const salesMaxRow = await this.getAsync(
        'SELECT MAX(id) AS maxId, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, MAX(doc_number) AS maxDoc FROM sales'
      ).catch(() => null);

      let maxFromSales = 0;
      if (salesMaxRow) {
        maxFromSales = Math.max(Number(salesMaxRow.maxId || 0), Number(salesMaxRow.totalCount || 0));
        if (salesMaxRow.maxDoc) {
          const tailMatch = String(salesMaxRow.maxDoc).match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
          if (tailMatch && tailMatch[1]) {
            const tailNum = parseInt(tailMatch[1], 10);
            if (!isNaN(tailNum) && tailNum < 10000000) {
              maxFromSales = Math.max(maxFromSales, tailNum);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const baseValue = Math.max(storedSeq, maxFromSales, (Number(startAt) || 1) - 1);
      const nextVal = baseValue + 1;

      // 3. حفظ الرقم الجديد في جدول settings (وجدول counters إن وجد)
      await this.runAsync(
        'INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
        [settingKey, String(nextVal)]
      ).catch(() =>
        this.runAsync('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [settingKey, String(nextVal)])
      );

      await this.runAsync(
        'UPDATE counters SET seq = ? WHERE name = ? OR key = ?',
        [nextVal, cleanKey, cleanKey]
      ).catch(() => {});

      if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null, nextVal);
      return nextVal;
    } catch (err) {
      const fallback = Date.now() % 100000;
      if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null, fallback);
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  async executeTx(workFn) {
    const runTx = async () => {
      const spName = `sp_gherbi_${++this.spCounter}_${Date.now()}`;
      this.txDepth++;
      try {
        await this.runAsync(`SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        const result = await workFn(this.db || this);
        await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch((err) => {
          if (!isBenignTxError(err)) throw err;
        });
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        await this.runAsync(`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch(() => {});
        await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`).catch(() => {});
        throw err;
      } finally {
        this.txDepth = Math.max(0, this.txDepth - 1);
      }
    };

    if (this.txDepth > 0) {
      return runTx();
    }
    return this.enqueue(runTx);
  }

  async transaction(workFn) {
    return this.executeTx(workFn);
  }
}

function attachWriteQueue(db) {
  if (!db) return db;
  if (db._rawRun && db.dbRun && db.getSetting && db.setSetting && db.nextNumber) {
    return db;
  }

  const origRun = db._rawRun || db.run.bind(db);
  const origGet = db._rawGet || db.get.bind(db);
  const origAll = db._rawAll || db.all.bind(db);
  const origExec = db._rawExec || db.exec.bind(db);
  const origPrepare = typeof db.prepare === 'function' ? db.prepare.bind(db) : null;
  const origSerialize = typeof db.serialize === 'function' ? db.serialize.bind(db) : null;

  db._rawRun = function rawRunWrapper(sql, params, callback) {
    if (typeof params === 'function') {
      callback = params;
      params = [];
    }
    return origRun(sql, params, function onRawComplete(err) {
      if (err && isBenignTxError(err)) {
        if (typeof callback === 'function') return callback.call(this, null);
        return;
      }
      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        return callback.call(this, err);
      }
    });
  };

  db._rawGet = origGet;
  db._rawAll = origAll;
  db._rawExec = function rawExecWrapper(sql, callback) {
    return origExec(sql, function onExecComplete(err) {
      if (err && isBenignTxError(err)) {
        if (typeof callback === 'function') return callback.call(this, null);
        return;
      }
      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        return callback.call(this, err);
      }
    });
  };
  if (origPrepare) db._rawPrepare = origPrepare;
  if (origSerialize) db._rawSerialize = origSerialize;

  db.run = db._rawRun;

  const queue = new DbWriteQueue(() => db);
  activeQueueInstance = queue;

  db._writeQueue = queue;
  db.getWriteQueueStats = queue.getStats.bind(queue);
  db.writeQueue = queue;

  db.dbRun = queue.dbRun.bind(queue);
  db.dbGet = queue.dbGet.bind(queue);
  db.dbAll = queue.dbAll.bind(queue);
  db.dbExec = queue.dbExec.bind(queue);

  db.runAsync = queue.runAsync.bind(queue);
  db.getAsync = queue.getAsync.bind(queue);
  db.allAsync = queue.allAsync.bind(queue);
  db.execAsync = queue.execAsync.bind(queue);

  db.nextNumber = queue.nextNumber.bind(queue);
  db.getNextNumber = queue.nextNumber.bind(queue);

  db.executeTx = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.transaction = queue.transaction.bind(queue);
  db.withTransaction = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.runInTransaction = queue.executeTx.bind(queue);
  db.enqueueWrite = queue.enqueue.bind(queue);
  db.enqueue = queue.enqueue.bind(queue);

  if (typeof db.getSetting !== 'function') {
    db.getSetting = function getSetting(key, defaultValue = null, callback = null) {
      if (typeof defaultValue === 'function') {
        callback = defaultValue;
        defaultValue = null;
      }
      const p = queue
        .getAsync('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)])
        .then((row) => (row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : defaultValue))
        .catch(() => defaultValue);

      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        p.then((val) => callback(null, val));
      }
      return p;
    };
  }

  if (typeof db.setSetting !== 'function') {
    db.setSetting = function setSetting(key, value, callback = null) {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const strVal = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
      const p = queue
        .runAsync(
          'INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
          [strKey, strVal]
        )
        .catch(() =>
          queue.runAsync('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [strKey, strVal])
        );

      if (typeof callback === 'function') {
        p.then((res) => callback(null, res)).catch((err) => callback(err));
      }
      return p;
    };
  }

  return db;
}

async function executeTx(workFn) {
  if (activeQueueInstance) {
    return activeQueueInstance.executeTx(workFn);
  }
  return workFn();
}

function getWriteQueue() {
  return activeQueueInstance;
}

module.exports = attachWriteQueue;
module.exports.attachWriteQueue = attachWriteQueue;
module.exports.DbWriteQueue = DbWriteQueue;
module.exports.executeTx = executeTx;
module.exports.getWriteQueue = getWriteQueue;

async function isLanClientMode() {

  async function pspPrecisionPdfHandler(_event, arg1, arg2) {
    const opts = normArgs(arg1, arg2);
    const html = String(opts.html || '');
    if (!html) return { success: false, ok: false, error: 'empty_html' };

    const paper = detectPaperStrict(html, opts);

    const { pdfBuf, widthMm, heightMm } = await renderInHiddenWindowV2(html, paper, async (win, dim) => {
      if (dim.isThermal) {
        const wIn = Number((dim.widthMm / 25.4).toFixed(4));
        const hIn = Number((dim.heightMm / 25.4).toFixed(4));
        const buf = await win.webContents.printToPDF({
          printBackground: true,
          landscape: false,
          preferCSSPageSize: false,
          scale: 1,
          margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 },
          pageSize: { width: wIn, height: hIn }
        });
        return { pdfBuf: buf, widthMm: dim.widthMm, heightMm: dim.heightMm };
      }

      const buf = await win.webContents.printToPDF({
        printBackground: true,
        landscape: dim.paperSize === '2xa5',
        preferCSSPageSize: true,
        margins: { top: 0.2, bottom: 0.2, left: 0.2, right: 0.2 },
        pageSize: dim.paperSize === 'a5' ? 'A5' : 'A4'
      });
      return { pdfBuf: buf, widthMm: dim.widthMm, heightMm: dim.heightMm };
    });

    // التحقق الفعلي من مقاس الـ MediaBox داخل ملف الـ PDF الناتج
    let actualMediaBoxMm = widthMm + 'mm x ' + heightMm + 'mm';
    try {
      const mb = pdfBuf.toString('latin1').match(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*0\s+0\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)\s*\]/);
      if (mb) {
        const wMmReal = ((parseFloat(mb[1]) * 25.4) / 72).toFixed(1);
        const hMmReal = ((parseFloat(mb[2]) * 25.4) / 72).toFixed(1);
        actualMediaBoxMm = wMmReal + 'mm x ' + hMmReal + 'mm';
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    let targetPath = opts.filePath || opts.savePath || '';
    if (!targetPath) {
      const baseName = String(opts.filename || opts.defaultPath || ('ticket_' + paper + '_' + Date.now() + '.pdf')).replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]+/g, '_');
      const dlgRes = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed() ? mainWindow : undefined, {
        title: 'حفظ التذكرة بصيغة PDF (' + paper.toUpperCase() + ' حقيقي)',
        defaultPath: baseName.endsWith('.pdf') ? baseName : baseName + '.pdf',
        filters: [{ name: 'PDF Document', extensions: ['pdf'] }]
      });
      if (dlgRes.canceled || !dlgRes.filePath) {
        return { success: false, ok: false, canceled: true };
      }
      targetPath = dlgRes.filePath;
    }

    fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, pdfBuf);
    console.log('[PSP-80MM-ENFORCER] PDF Saved -> ' + actualMediaBoxMm + ' | File: ' + path.basename(targetPath));
    if (opts.openAfterSave !== false) {
      try { shell.openPath(targetPath); } catch (_) {}
    }
    return { success: true, ok: true, filePath: targetPath, path: targetPath, paperSize: paper, actualMediaBoxMm };
  }

  async function pspPrecisionPrintHandler(_event, arg1, arg2) {
    const opts = normArgs(arg1, arg2);
    const html = String(opts.html || '');
    if (!html) return { success: false, ok: false, error: 'empty_html' };
    if (opts.asPdf === true) return await pspPrecisionPdfHandler(_event, opts);

    const paper = detectPaperStrict(html, opts);
    const isThermal = paper === '80mm' || paper === '58mm';
    console.log('[PSP-80MM-TRACE] Print Request -> detectedPaper=' + paper + ' | optsPaper=' + String(opts.paperSize || '') + ' | silent=' + Boolean(opts.silent) + ' | printer=' + String(opts.printerName || opts.deviceName || '(default)'));
    const silent = Boolean(opts.silent);
    const copies = Math.max(1, Number(opts.copies || 1));
    const deviceName = String(opts.printerName || opts.deviceName || '').trim() || undefined;

    // للتذاكر الحرارية (80mm / 58mm):
    // إذا لم يحدد المستخدم طابعة في مركز الطباعة، نفحص الطابعة الافتراضية على ويندوز:
    // إذا لم تكن طابعة حرارية حقيقية (مثلاً Microsoft Print to PDF أو طابعة A4 أو افتراضية وهمية)،
    // نُخرج PDF حرارياً حقيقياً بمقاس 80mm / 58mm مباشرةً حتى لا تفرض Microsoft Print to PDF مقاس A4!
    if (isThermal) {
      if (deviceName && VIRTUAL_PDF_RE.test(deviceName)) {
        return await pspPrecisionPdfHandler(_event, { ...opts, paperSize: paper, asPdf: true });
      }
      if (!deviceName) {
        let defPrinterName = '';
        try {
          if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed() && typeof mainWindow.webContents.getPrintersAsync === 'function') {
            const printers = await mainWindow.webContents.getPrintersAsync();
            const defP = (printers || []).find((p) => p && p.isDefault);
            defPrinterName = defP ? String(defP.name || defP.displayName || '') : '';
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        const isRealThermalDefault = defPrinterName && THERMAL_PRINTER_RE.test(defPrinterName) && !VIRTUAL_PDF_RE.test(defPrinterName);
        if (!isRealThermalDefault) {
          console.log('[PSP-80MM-ENFORCER] Default printer ("' + (defPrinterName || 'none') + '") is not a thermal printer -> routing to TRUE ' + paper + ' PDF.');
          return await pspPrecisionPdfHandler(_event, { ...opts, paperSize: paper, asPdf: true });
        }
      }
    }

    return await renderInHiddenWindowV2(html, paper, (win, dim) => {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const printOpts = {
          silent,
          printBackground: true,
          copies,
          deviceName,
          landscape: dim.paperSize === '2xa5',
          margins: { marginType: dim.isThermal ? 'none' : 'default' },
          pageSize: dim.isThermal
            ? { width: dim.widthMm * 1000, height: dim.heightMm * 1000 }
            : dim.paperSize === 'a5'
            ? 'A5'
            : 'A4'
        };
        win.webContents.print(printOpts, (success, failureReason) => {
          resolve({
            success: Boolean(success),
            ok: Boolean(success),
            error: success ? null : String(failureReason || 'print_canceled'),
            paperSize: paper
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function registerEnforcerChannels() {
    const pdfList = ['psp-precision-pdf', 'export-pdf', 'export-html-to-pdf', 'print-to-pdf', 'save-html-to-pdf'];
    const printList = ['psp-precision-print', 'print-html', 'print-silent', 'print-document', 'print-receipt'];

      try { ipcMain.removeHandler(ch); } catch (_) {}
      ipcMain.handle(ch, pspPrecisionPrintHandler);
    }

  }

const invoke = (channel, ...args) => ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, ...args);

function createEventSubscriber(channel) {
  return (callback) => {
    if (typeof callback !== 'function') return () => {};
    const handler = (_event, payload) => callback(payload);
    ipcRenderer.on(channel, handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, handler);
  };
}

 * تسجيل حدث أمني في جدول الرقابة ومنع التلاعب (audit_logs)
 */
async function recordAuditLog(payload = {}) {
  const userId = payload.user_id || payload.userId || null;
  const userName = payload.user_name || payload.userName || 'Cashier';
  const actionType = String(payload.action_type || payload.actionType || 'event');
  const targetType = payload.target_type || payload.targetType || null;
  const targetId = payload.target_id || payload.targetId || null;
  const severity = payload.severity || 'info';
  const detailsJson =
    typeof payload.details === 'string'
      ? payload.details
      : JSON.stringify(payload.details || payload.details_json || {});

  const ins = await db.dbRun(
    `INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, user_name, action_type, target_type, target_id, details_json, severity)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [userId, userName, actionType, targetType, targetId, detailsJson, severity]
  );
  return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };
}

/**
 * إنشاء خطة تقسيط وجدول أقساط شهري (Vente par Facilité)
 */
async function createInstallmentPlanRecord(payload = {}) {
  const customerId = Number(payload.customer_id || payload.customerId);
  if (!customerId) throw new Error('يرجى تحديد الزبون لإنشاء عقد البيع بالتقسيط');

  const saleId = payload.sale_id || payload.saleId ? Number(payload.sale_id || payload.saleId) : null;
  const totalAmount = Number(payload.total_amount ?? payload.totalAmount ?? 0);
  const downPayment = Number(payload.down_payment ?? payload.downPayment ?? 0);
  const remainingAmount = Math.max(0, Number((totalAmount - downPayment).toFixed(2)));
  const monthsCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(payload.months_count ?? payload.monthsCount ?? 3, 10) || 3);
  const monthlyAmount = Number((remainingAmount / monthsCount).toFixed(2));
  const startDate = payload.start_date || payload.startDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const notes = payload.notes || null;

  return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
    const ins = await db.dbRun(
      `INSERT INTO installment_plans (
        sale_id, customer_id, total_amount, down_payment, remaining_amount,
        months_count, monthly_amount, start_date, status, notes
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)`,
      [saleId, customerId, totalAmount, downPayment, remainingAmount, monthsCount, monthlyAmount, startDate, notes]
    );
    const planId = ins.lastID;

    let allocated = 0;
    const baseDate = new Date(startDate);
    for (let i = 1; i <= monthsCount; i++) {
      const due = new Date(baseDate);
      due.setMonth(due.getMonth() + i);
      const dueStr = due.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const amt =
        i === monthsCount
          ? Number((remainingAmount - allocated).toFixed(2))
          : monthlyAmount;
      allocated = Number((allocated + amt).toFixed(2));

      await db.dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO installment_schedules (plan_id, installment_num, due_date, amount, paid_amount, status)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 'pending')`,
        [planId, i, dueStr, amt]
      );
    }

    return { success: true, id: planId, planId };
  });
}

/**
 * بناء استعلام الفرز المتقدم للمنتجات (newest, oldest, name_asc, name_desc, stock_asc, stock_desc, expiry_asc)
 */
function buildProductsQueryOrder(sortKey = '') {
  const s = String(sortKey || '').toLowerCase();
  let orderBySql = 'ORDER BY p.id DESC';
  let needsStockJoin = false;

  if (s === 'oldest') {
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY p.id ASC';
  } else if (s === 'name_asc') {
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, p.id ASC';
  } else if (s === 'name_desc') {
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE DESC, p.id DESC';
  } else if (s === 'stock_asc') {
    needsStockJoin = true;
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY COALESCE(st.total_stock, 0) ASC, p.id DESC';
  } else if (s === 'stock_desc') {
    needsStockJoin = true;
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY COALESCE(st.total_stock, 0) DESC, p.id DESC';
  } else if (s === 'expiry_asc') {
    needsStockJoin = true;
    orderBySql = 'ORDER BY (st.next_expiry IS NULL) ASC, st.next_expiry ASC, p.id DESC';
  }

  const stockJoinSql = needsStockJoin
    ? `LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
           product_id,
           SUM(stock) AS total_stock,
           MIN(CASE WHEN stock > 0 AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date <> '' AND date(expiry_date) >= date('now') THEN expiry_date END) AS next_expiry
         FROM inventory_batches
         WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
         GROUP BY product_id
       ) st ON st.product_id = p.id`
    : '';

  return { stockJoinSql, orderBySql };
}

/**
 * إثراء قائمة المنتجات بالدفعات، الرصيد الصالح/المنتهي، الأسعار المتعددة، الباركودات، والمتغيرات
 */
async function enrichProductsFull(products = []) {
  if (!Array.isArray(products) || products.length === 0) return [];
  const productIds = products.map((p) => Number(p.id)).filter(Boolean);
  if (productIds.length === 0) return products;

  const ph = productIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const [allBatches, allBarcodes, allPrices, allVariants, allPromos] = await Promise.all([
    db.dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM inventory_batches
       WHERE product_id IN (${ph}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
       ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC`,
      productIds
    ),
    db.dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM product_barcodes WHERE product_id IN (${ph}) AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      productIds
    ),
    db.dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM product_prices WHERE product_id IN (${ph}) AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      productIds
    ),
    db.dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM product_variants WHERE product_id IN (${ph}) AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      productIds
    ),
    db.dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM product_promotions
       WHERE product_id IN (${ph}) AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      productIds
    )
  ]);

  const batchesMap = new Map();
  for (const b of allBatches) {
    if (!batchesMap.has(b.product_id)) batchesMap.set(b.product_id, []);
    batchesMap.get(b.product_id).push(b);
  }

  const barcodesMap = new Map();
  for (const bc of allBarcodes) {
    if (!barcodesMap.has(bc.product_id)) barcodesMap.set(bc.product_id, []);
    barcodesMap.get(bc.product_id).push(bc);
  }

  const pricesMap = new Map();
  for (const pr of allPrices) {
    if (!pricesMap.has(pr.product_id)) pricesMap.set(pr.product_id, []);
    pricesMap.get(pr.product_id).push(pr);
  }

  const variantsMap = new Map();
  for (const v of allVariants) {
    if (!variantsMap.has(v.product_id)) variantsMap.set(v.product_id, []);
    variantsMap.get(v.product_id).push(v);
  }

  const promosMap = new Map();
  for (const prm of allPromos) {
    promosMap.set(prm.product_id, prm);
  }

  return products.map((prod) => {
    const batches = batchesMap.get(prod.id) || [];
    let totalStock = 0;
    let validStock = 0;
    let expiredStock = 0;
    let nextExpiry = null;

    for (const b of batches) {
      const st = Number(b.stock || 0);
      totalStock += st;
      const isExpired = b.expiry_date && String(b.expiry_date).trim() !== '' && String(b.expiry_date) < todayIso;
      if (isExpired) {
        if (st > 0) expiredStock += st;
      } else {
        validStock += st;
        if (st > 0 && b.expiry_date && (!nextExpiry || String(b.expiry_date) < nextExpiry)) {
          nextExpiry = b.expiry_date;
        }
      }
    }

    const activeBatch =
      batches.find((b) => Number(b.stock) > 0 && (!b.expiry_date || String(b.expiry_date) >= todayIso)) ||
      batches.find((b) => Number(b.stock) > 0) ||
      batches[0] ||
      {};

    const extraBarcodes = barcodesMap.get(prod.id) || [];
    const extraPrices = pricesMap.get(prod.id) || [];
    const variants = variantsMap.get(prod.id) || [];
    const promo = promosMap.get(prod.id) || null;

    return {
      ...prod,
      stock: Number(totalStock.toFixed(4)),
      total_stock: Number(totalStock.toFixed(4)),
      valid_stock: Number(validStock.toFixed(4)),
      expired_qty: Number(expiredStock.toFixed(4)),
      next_expiry: nextExpiry,
      cost_price: Number(activeBatch.cost_price ?? prod.cost_price ?? 0),
      selling_price: Number(activeBatch.selling_price ?? prod.selling_price ?? 0),
      wholesale_price:
        activeBatch.wholesale_price !== undefined && activeBatch.wholesale_price !== null
          ? Number(activeBatch.wholesale_price)
          : (prod.wholesale_price !== undefined && prod.wholesale_price !== null && prod.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(prod.wholesale_price) : null),
      expiry_date: activeBatch.expiry_date || null,
      location: activeBatch.location || null,
      batches,
      extra_barcodes: extraBarcodes,
      barcodes: extraBarcodes.map((x) => x.barcode),
      extra_prices: extraPrices,
      variants,
      active_promotion: promo
    };
  });
}

async function getProductFullDetails(productId) {
  const pid = Number(productId);
  const prod = await db.dbGet('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [pid]);
  if (!prod) return null;

  const [enriched] = await enrichProductsFull([prod]);
  const optionGroups = await db.dbAll(
    'SELECT * FROM product_option_groups WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC',
    [pid]
  );

  for (const g of optionGroups) {
    g.values = await db.dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM product_option_values WHERE option_group_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC',
      [g.id]
    );
  }

  enriched.option_groups = optionGroups;
  return enriched;
}

/**
 * جلب تفاصيل الدفعة المالية مع حساب الرصيد السابق والمتبقي (Payment Receipt Parity)
 */
async function getPaymentDetailsFull(paymentId, type = 'sale') {
  const isSale = type !== 'invoice' && type !== 'purchase';
  const table = isSale ? 'sale_payments' : 'invoice_payments';
  const partyTable = isSale ? 'customers' : 'suppliers';
  const partyFk = isSale ? 'customer_id' : 'supplier_id';
  const docTable = isSale ? 'sales' : 'purchase_invoices';
  const docFk = isSale ? 'sale_id' : 'invoice_id';

  const payment = await db.dbGet(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE id = ?`, [Number(paymentId)]);
  if (!payment) return null;

  let partyId = payment[partyFk];
  if (!partyId && payment[docFk]) {
    const docRow = await db.dbGet(`SELECT ${partyFk} FROM ${docTable} WHERE id = ?`, [payment[docFk]]);
    if (docRow) partyId = docRow[partyFk];
  }

  const party = partyId
    ? await db.dbGet(`SELECT * FROM ${partyTable} WHERE id = ?`, [partyId])
    : null;

  let currentTotalDebt = 0;
  if (party) {
    const docsDebtRow = await db.dbGet(
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - paid_amount), 0) AS docs_debt FROM ${docTable} WHERE ${partyFk} = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [party.id]
    );
    const initRem = Math.max(0, Number(party.initial_debt || 0) - Number(party.initial_debt_paid || 0));
    currentTotalDebt = initRem + Number((docsDebtRow && docsDebtRow.docs_debt) || 0);
  }

  const amt = Number(payment.amount || 0);
  const debtAfter = Number(currentTotalDebt.toFixed(2));
  const debtBefore = Number((currentTotalDebt + amt).toFixed(2));

  return {
    ...payment,
    type: isSale ? 'sale' : 'purchase',
    party_id: party ? party.id : null,
    party_name: party ? party.name : '',
    party_phone: party ? party.phone : '',
    party_address: party ? party.address : '',
    party_nif: party ? party.nif : '',
    party_rc: party ? party.rc : '',
    party,
    debt_before: debtBefore,
    debt_after: debtAfter
  };
}

/**
 * المعاملة الذرية الشاملة لإتمام أو تعديل فاتورة بيع (executeSaleTransaction)
 * تدعم: التصنيع الفوري، FIFO، ديون المخزون، الدفع المختلط (Split Payment)، البيع بالتقسيط، والضمان
 */
let _saleItemsSchemaChecked = false;
async function ensureSaleItemsColumnsExist() {
  if (_saleItemsSchemaChecked) return;
  _saleItemsSchemaChecked = true;
  const cols = [
    ['sale_items', 'bonus_qty REAL DEFAULT 0'],
    ['sale_items', 'pack_count REAL DEFAULT 0'],
    ['sale_items', 'pack_multiplier REAL DEFAULT 1'],
    ['sale_items', 'sold_m2 REAL DEFAULT 0'],
    ['sale_items', 'warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0']
  ];
  for (const [t, c] of cols) {
    try { await db.dbRun(`ALTER TABLE ${t} ADD COLUMN ${c}`); } catch (_) {}
  }
}

async function executeSaleTransaction(saleData = {}) {
  await ensureSaleItemsColumnsExist();
  const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
  if (items.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('لا يمكن حفظ فاتورة بيع فارغة بدون منتجات');
  }

  const editSaleId = saleData.editSaleId || saleData.edit_sale_id ? Number(saleData.editSaleId || saleData.edit_sale_id) : null;
  const customerId = saleData.customer_id || saleData.customerId ? Number(saleData.customer_id || saleData.customerId) : null;
  const userId = saleData.user_id || saleData.userId ? Number(saleData.user_id || saleData.userId) : null;
  const sessionId = saleData.session_id || saleData.sessionId ? Number(saleData.session_id || saleData.sessionId) : null;
  const subtotal = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? 0);
  const taxPercentage = Number(saleData.tax_percentage ?? saleData.taxPercentage ?? 0);
  const discount = Number(saleData.discount ?? 0);
  const stampAmount = Number(saleData.stamp_amount ?? saleData.stampAmount ?? 0);
  const total = Number(saleData.total ?? 0);
  const paidAmount = Number(saleData.paid_amount ?? saleData.paidAmount ?? total);
  const paymentMethod = String(saleData.payment_method || saleData.paymentMethod || 'cash').toLowerCase();
  const splitPaymentsJson = saleData.split_payments
    ? JSON.stringify(saleData.split_payments)
    : saleData.split_payments_json || null;
  const dueDate = saleData.due_date || saleData.dueDate || null;
  const saleDate = saleData.sale_date || saleData.saleDate || new Date().toISOString();

  // التحقق من مهلة تعديل الفاتورة إن كان تعديلاً
  if (editSaleId) {
    const existingSale = await db.dbGet('SELECT id, sale_date, deleted_at FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [editSaleId]);
    if (!existingSale || existingSale.deleted_at) {
      throw new Error('الفاتورة المطلوبة غير موجودة أو محذوفة');
    }
    const winDays = parseInt(await db.getSetting('sale_edit_window_days', '30'), 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(winDays) && winDays > 0 && existingSale.sale_date) {
      const diffDays = (Date.now() - new Date(existingSale.sale_date).getTime()) / 86400000;
      if (diffDays > winDays) {
        throw new Error(`انتهت المهلة المسموحة لتعديل الفاتورة (${winDays} يوماً)`);
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    await posProduce.autoProduceShortfallsForSale(db, items, { userId });
  } catch (_) {}

  return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
    let saleId = editSaleId;
    let docNumber = saleData.doc_number || saleData.docNumber || null;

    if (editSaleId) {
      const oldItems = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [editSaleId]);
      /* [V24_EDIT_SALE_RESTORE_SERIAL_AND_PROMO] */
      for (const oldIt of oldItems) {
        if (oldIt.batch_id && Number(oldIt.sold_without_stock || 0) === 0) {
          await batchAlloc.restoreBatch(db, {
            batchId: oldIt.batch_id,
            quantity: Number(oldIt.quantity || 0) + Number(oldIt.bonus_qty || 0),
            soldWithoutStock: oldIt.sold_without_stock
          });
        }
        /* [V25_LAN_RESTORE_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS] */
        if (!oldIt.product_id && !oldIt.batch_id && oldIt.custom_product_name && Number(oldIt.quantity || 0) > 0) {
          const bRow = await db.dbGet('SELECT id FROM product_bundles WHERE name = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1', [String(oldIt.custom_product_name).trim()]).catch(() => null);
          if (bRow && bRow.id) {
            const bComps = await db.dbAll('SELECT product_id, quantity FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [bRow.id]).catch(() => []);
            for (const bc of bComps) {
              const restoreQty = Number((Number(bc.quantity || 1) * Number(oldIt.quantity || 1)).toFixed(6));
              const targetBatch = await db.dbGet('SELECT id FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', [bc.product_id]).catch(() => null);
              if (targetBatch && targetBatch.id && restoreQty > 0) {
                await batchAlloc.restoreBatch(db, { batchId: targetBatch.id, quantity: restoreQty, soldWithoutStock: 0 });
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (oldIt.applied_promotion_id && Number(oldIt.quantity || 0) > 0) {
          await db.dbRun(
            'UPDATE product_promotions SET used_qty = MAX(0, COALESCE(used_qty, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
            [Number(oldIt.quantity || 0), Number(oldIt.applied_promotion_id)]
          ).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
      await db.dbRun(
        "UPDATE product_serials SET status = 'in_stock', sale_id = NULL WHERE sale_id = ?",
        [editSaleId]
      ).catch(() => {});
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM stock_debt WHERE sale_id = ?', [editSaleId]);
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ?', [editSaleId]);
      /* [V21_EDIT_SALE_LOYALTY_AND_PAYMENTS_SYNC] */
      const prevSaleRow = await db.dbGet('SELECT customer_id FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [editSaleId]).catch(() => null);
      const prevCustId = prevSaleRow && prevSaleRow.customer_id ? Number(prevSaleRow.customer_id) : customerId;
      if (prevCustId) {
        const lRow = await db.dbGet(
          'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_delta), 0) AS net_pts FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
          [editSaleId]
        ).catch(() => null);
        const netPts = Number((lRow && lRow.net_pts) || 0);
        if (Math.abs(netPts) > 0.001) {
          await db.dbRun(
            'UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = MAX(0, COALESCE(loyalty_points, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
            [netPts, prevCustId]
          ).catch(() => {});
        }
        await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE sale_id = ?', [editSaleId]).catch(() => {});
      }
      /* [V23_EDIT_SALE_CLEAN_DEBT_TILL] */
      await db.dbRun(
        "DELETE FROM caisse_transactions WHERE type = 'debt_payment' AND reference_id IN (SELECT id FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ?)",
        [editSaleId]
      ).catch(() => {});
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ?', [editSaleId]).catch(() => {});
      if (Math.abs(paidAmount) > 0.009) {
        await db.dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [editSaleId, customerId, paidAmount, saleDate, paymentMethod]
        ).catch(() => {});
      }

      await db.dbRun(
        `UPDATE sales
         SET customer_id = ?, subtotal = ?, tax_percentage = ?, discount = ?,
             total = ?, paid_amount = ?, due_date = ?, sale_date = ?,
             user_id = COALESCE(?, user_id), session_id = COALESCE(?, session_id),
             stamp_amount = ?, payment_method = ?, split_payments_json = ?
         WHERE id = ?`,
        [
          customerId,
          subtotal,
          taxPercentage,
          discount,
          total,
          paidAmount,
          dueDate,
          saleDate,
          userId,
          sessionId,
          stampAmount,
          paymentMethod,
          splitPaymentsJson,
          editSaleId
        ]
      );

      await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO document_edit_history (doc_type, doc_id, user_id, changes_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
        ['sale', editSaleId, userId, JSON.stringify({ total, paidAmount, itemsCount: items.length })]
      );
      await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO sync_outbox (event_type, payload_json) VALUES (?, ?)',
        ['sale_updated', JSON.stringify({ sale_id: editSaleId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })]
      );
    } else {
      if (!docNumber) {
        docNumber = await generateNextDocNumber('invoice');
      }
      const activeSessId = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, sessionId, userId);

      const ins = await db.dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO sales (
          doc_number, customer_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, discount,
          total, paid_amount, due_date, sale_date, user_id, session_id,
          stamp_amount, payment_method, split_payments_json
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          docNumber,
          customerId,
          subtotal,
          taxPercentage,
          discount,
          total,
          paidAmount,
          dueDate,
          saleDate,
          userId,
          activeSessId,
          stampAmount,
          paymentMethod,
          splitPaymentsJson
        ]
      );
      saleId = ins.lastID;

      // تسجيل الدفعات (سواء كانت دفعة موحدة أو دفعاً مختلطاً Split Payment)
      if (Array.isArray(saleData.split_payments) && saleData.split_payments.length > 0) {
        for (const sp of saleData.split_payments) {
          const spAmt = Number(sp.amount || 0);
          if (Math.abs(spAmt) > 0.009) {
            await db.dbRun(
              `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
              [saleId, customerId, spAmt, saleDate, sp.method || 'cash', sp.reference || null]
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (Math.abs(paidAmount) > 0.009) {
        await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [saleId, customerId, paidAmount, saleDate, paymentMethod]
        );
      }
    }

    for (const item of items) {
      const isBundle = Boolean(item.bundle_id || item.bundleId || item.is_bundle);
      const productId = item.product_id || item.productId ? Number(item.product_id || item.productId) : null;
      const variantId = item.variant_id || item.variantId ? Number(item.variant_id || item.variantId) : null;
      const preferredBatchId = item.batch_id || item.batchId ? Number(item.batch_id || item.batchId) : null;
      const qty = Number(item.quantity ?? 1);
      const price = Number(item.price ?? item.selling_price ?? 0);
      const lineSubtotal = Number(item.subtotal ?? (qty * price));
      const promoId = item.applied_promotion_id || item.promotion_id || null;
      const warrantyMonths = Number(item.warranty_months || 0);

      if (isBundle) {
        const bundleId = Number(item.bundle_id || item.bundleId);
        const bundleComponents = await db.dbAll(
          'SELECT product_id, quantity FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
          [bundleId]
        );
        let bundleTotalCost = 0;

        for (const bc of bundleComponents) {
          const compNeed = Number((Number(bc.quantity || 1) * qty).toFixed(6));
          const alloc = await batchAlloc.deductFromBatch(db, {
            productId: bc.product_id,
            quantity: compNeed
          });
          bundleTotalCost += Number(alloc.costPrice || 0) * Number(bc.quantity || 1);

          if (alloc.shortfallQty > 0) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO stock_debt (product_id, batch_id, sale_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
              [bc.product_id, alloc.primaryBatchId, saleId, alloc.shortfallQty]
            );
          }
        }

        await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO sale_items (
            sale_id, product_id, quantity, price, subtotal, cost_price, custom_product_name
          ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            saleId,
            qty,
            price,
            lineSubtotal,
            Number(bundleTotalCost.toFixed(2)),
            item.custom_product_name || item.name || 'حزمة منتجات'
          ]
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (!productId) {
        await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO sale_items (
            sale_id, product_id, quantity, price, subtotal, cost_price,
            custom_product_name, custom_cost_price, sold_without_stock
          ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)`,
          [
            saleId,
            qty,
            price,
            lineSubtotal,
            Number(item.custom_cost_price ?? item.cost_price ?? 0),
            item.custom_product_name || item.name || 'منتج حر',
            Number(item.custom_cost_price ?? item.cost_price ?? 0)
          ]
        );
        continue;
      }

      const bonusQty = Math.max(0, Number(item.bonus_qty || item.bonusQty || 0));
      const packCount = Math.max(0, Number(item.pack_count || item.packCount || 0));
      const packMultiplier = Math.max(1, Number(item.pack_multiplier || item.packMultiplier || 1));
      const soldM2 = Math.max(0, Number(item.sold_m2 || item.soldM2 || 0));

      const alloc = await batchAlloc.deductFromBatch(db, {
        productId,
        variantId,
        batchId: preferredBatchId,
        quantity: qty
      });

      if (bonusQty > 0) {
        await batchAlloc.deductFromBatch(db, {
          productId,
          variantId,
          batchId: preferredBatchId,
          quantity: bonusQty
        });
      }

      if (alloc.allocations && alloc.allocations.length > 0) {
        let isFirstSlice = true;
        for (const slice of alloc.allocations) {
          const sliceSub = Number((slice.quantity * price).toFixed(2));
          await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO sale_items (
              sale_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price,
              subtotal, cost_price, applied_promotion_id, serial_number, warranty_months, sold_without_stock,
              bonus_qty, pack_count, pack_multiplier, sold_m2
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
            [
              saleId,
              productId,
              slice.batchId || null,
              slice.variantId || variantId || null,
              slice.quantity,
              price,
              sliceSub,
              slice.costPrice !== null && slice.costPrice !== undefined
                ? Number(slice.costPrice)
                : Number(item.cost_price || 0),
              promoId,
              item.serial_number || null,
              warrantyMonths,
              slice.soldWithoutStock ? 1 : 0,
              isFirstSlice ? bonusQty : 0,
              isFirstSlice ? packCount : 0,
              packMultiplier,
              isFirstSlice ? soldM2 : 0
            ]
          );
          isFirstSlice = false;

          if (slice.soldWithoutStock && slice.quantity > 0) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO stock_debt (product_id, variant_id, batch_id, sale_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
              [productId, slice.variantId || variantId || null, slice.batchId || null, saleId, slice.quantity]
            );
          }
        }
      } else {
        await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO sale_items (
            sale_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price, subtotal, cost_price, serial_number, warranty_months, sold_without_stock
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)`,
          [
            saleId,
            productId,
            preferredBatchId,
            variantId,
            qty,
            price,
            lineSubtotal,
            Number(item.cost_price || 0),
            item.serial_number || null,
            warrantyMonths
          ]
        );
      }

      if (item.serial_number) {
        await db.dbRun(
          "UPDATE product_serials SET status = 'sold', sale_id = ? WHERE serial_number = ?",
          [saleId, String(item.serial_number).trim()]
        );
      }

      if (promoId && qty > 0) {
        await db.dbRun(
          'UPDATE product_promotions SET used_qty = COALESCE(used_qty, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
          [qty, Number(promoId)]
        );
      }
    }

    // حساب النقد الفعلي الداخل للصندوق (سواء دفع موحد أو مختلط)
    let cashPortion = paidAmount;
    if (Array.isArray(saleData.split_payments) && saleData.split_payments.length > 0) {
      cashPortion = saleData.split_payments
        .filter((sp) => !sp.method || String(sp.method).toLowerCase() === 'cash')
        .reduce((sum, sp) => sum + Number(sp.amount || 0), 0);
    }

    await tillLedger.applySaleTillDelta(db, {
      saleId,
      sessionId,
      userId,
      paidAmount: cashPortion,
      totalAmount: total,
      paymentMethod: Array.isArray(saleData.split_payments) ? 'cash' : paymentMethod
    });

    // إنشاء خطة تقسيط تلقائياً إذا تم تفعيل خيار البيع بالتقسيط في نافذة الدفع
    if (saleData.installment_plan && customerId && !editSaleId) {
      await createInstallmentPlanRecord({
        sale_id: saleId,
        customer_id: customerId,
        total_amount: total,
        down_payment: paidAmount,
        months_count: saleData.installment_plan.months_count || 3,
        start_date: saleData.installment_plan.start_date || saleDate.slice(0, 10),
        notes: saleData.installment_plan.notes || `تقسيط فاتورة #${docNumber}`
      });
    }

    const redeemedPtsInSale = Math.max(0, Number(saleData.redeemed_loyalty_points || 0));
    if (customerId && redeemedPtsInSale > 0) {
      await db.dbRun(
        'UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = MAX(0, COALESCE(loyalty_points, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
        [redeemedPtsInSale, customerId]
      );
      await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO loyalty_transactions (customer_id, sale_id, points_delta, reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
        [customerId, saleId, -redeemedPtsInSale, `استعمال نقاط ولاء للخصم في فاتورة #${docNumber || saleId}`]
      );
    } else if (customerId && total > 0) {
      const loyaltyEnabled = (await db.getSetting('loyalty_enabled', 'true')) === 'true';
      if (loyaltyEnabled) {
        const ptsPer100 = Number(saleData.loyalty_points_per_100_dzd ?? (await db.getSetting('loyalty_points_per_100_dzd', '1'))) || 1;
        const earnedPoints = saleData.earned_loyalty_points !== undefined
          ? Math.max(0, Number(saleData.earned_loyalty_points))
          : Math.floor((total / 100) * ptsPer100);
        if (earnedPoints > 0) {
          await db.dbRun(
            'UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = COALESCE(loyalty_points, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
            [earnedPoints, customerId]
          );
          await db.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO loyalty_transactions (customer_id, sale_id, points_delta, reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
            [customerId, saleId, earnedPoints, `مكافأة فاتورة #${docNumber || saleId}`]
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      id: saleId,
      saleId,
      docNumber
    };
  });
}

let _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog = [];
const _kioskCacheFilePath = require('path').join(db && db.dbPath ? require('path').dirname(db.dbPath) : __dirname, 'kiosk-catalog-cache.json');

try {
  if (require('fs').existsSync(_kioskCacheFilePath)) {
    const cached = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(_kioskCacheFilePath, 'utf8'));
    if (Array.isArray(cached) && cached.length > 0) {
      _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog = cached;
    }
  }
} catch (_) {}

function _normArKiosk(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')
    .replace(/ى/g, 'ي')
    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه');
}

async function _loadCatalogFromSqliteSafely() {
  if (Array.isArray(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog) && _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog.length > 0) {
    return _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog;
  }

  return await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => resolve(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog || []), 1500);
    try {
      const dbMod = require('./database');
      const queueMod = require('./db-write-queue');
      const activeQ = queueMod && typeof queueMod.getWriteQueue === 'function' ? queueMod.getWriteQueue() : null;
      const rawDb = (activeQ && activeQ.db) || (dbMod && dbMod.db) || dbMod;

      const runAll = (sql, cb) => {
        if (activeQ && typeof activeQ.allAsync === 'function') {
          activeQ.allAsync(sql, []).then((rows) => cb(null, rows)).catch((e) => cb(e, []));
        } else if (rawDb && typeof rawDb.all === 'function') {
          rawDb.all(sql, [], cb);
        } else if (rawDb && typeof rawDb.dbAll === 'function') {
          rawDb.dbAll(sql, []).then((rows) => cb(null, rows)).catch((e) => cb(e, []));
        } else {
          cb(new Error('No db'), []);
        }
      };

      runAll('SELECT * FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL', (errP, prodRows) => {
        if (errP || !Array.isArray(prodRows)) {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          return resolve(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog || []);
        }
        runAll('SELECT * FROM inventory_batches WHERE deleted_at IS NULL', (_errB, batchRows) => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          const batches = Array.isArray(batchRows) ? batchRows : [];
          const batchByProd = {};

          batches.forEach((b) => {
            const pid = Number(b.product_id);
            if (!pid) return;
            if (!batchByProd[pid]) {
              batchByProd[pid] = { stock: 0, selling_price: 0, wholesale_price: 0 };
            }
            batchByProd[pid].stock += Number(b.stock || 0);
            if (Number(b.selling_price || 0) > 0) {
              batchByProd[pid].selling_price = Number(b.selling_price);
            }
            if (Number(b.wholesale_price || 0) > 0) {
              batchByProd[pid].wholesale_price = Number(b.wholesale_price);
            }
          });

          const merged = prodRows
            .filter((p) => !p.hide_from_pos)
            .map((p) => {
              const bInfo = batchByProd[Number(p.id)] || {};
              const sellPrice = Number(p.selling_price ?? p.price ?? bInfo.selling_price ?? 0);
              const packPrice = Number(p.wholesale_price ?? bInfo.wholesale_price ?? 0);
              const totalStock = Number(p.total_stock ?? (bInfo.stock !== undefined ? bInfo.stock : p.stock) ?? 0);
              return {
                id: p.id,
                name: p.name || '',
                barcode: p.barcode || '',
                plu_code: p.plu_code || '',
                category: p.category || '',
                unit: p.unit || 'قطعة',
                selling_price: sellPrice,
                effective_price: sellPrice,
                wholesale_price: packPrice,
                effective_pack_price: packPrice,
                wholesale_qty: Number(p.wholesale_qty || p.wholesale_min_qty || 0),
                total_stock: totalStock
              };
            });

          if (merged.length > 0) {
            _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog = merged;
          }
          resolve(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog);
        });
      });
    } catch (_) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      resolve(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog || []);
    }
  });
}

try {
  if (typeof app !== 'undefined' && app && typeof app.get === 'function') {
    // 1. استقبال المزامنة من Electron بدون حظر CORS (Simple Request text/plain)
    app.options('/api/kiosk/sync-catalog', (_req, res) => {
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'POST, GET, OPTIONS');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*');
      res.sendStatus(200);
    });

    app.post('/api/kiosk/sync-catalog', express.text({ type: '*/*', limit: '25mb' }), (req, res) => {
      const clientIp = String(req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress || '');
      if (!clientIp.includes('127.0.0.1') && !clientIp.includes('::1') && !clientIp.includes('localhost')) {
        return res.status(403).json({ ok: false, error: 'Localhost only' });
      }
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      try {
        const parsed = typeof req.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(req.body) : req.body;
        const arr = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.products) ? parsed.products : []);
        if (arr.length > 0) {
          _gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog = arr.map((p) => ({
            id: p.id,
            name: p.name || '',
            barcode: p.barcode || '',
            plu_code: p.plu_code || '',
            category: p.category || '',
            unit: p.unit || 'قطعة',
            selling_price: Number(p.selling_price ?? p.price ?? 0),
            effective_price: Number(p.selling_price ?? p.price ?? 0),
            wholesale_price: Number(p.wholesale_price ?? 0),
            effective_pack_price: Number(p.wholesale_price ?? 0),
            wholesale_qty: Number(p.wholesale_qty || p.wholesale_min_qty || 0),
            total_stock: Number(p.total_stock ?? p.stock ?? 0)
          }));
          try {
            require('fs').promises.writeFile(_kioskCacheFilePath, JSON.stringify(_gherbiMemoryKioskCatalog), 'utf8').catch(() => {});

        }

      } catch (e) {

      }

    // 2. تزويد المتصفح الخارجي بالكتالوج الكامل للبحث اللحظي (0ms)
    app.get('/api/kiosk/catalog', async (_req, res) => {

    // 3. مسار البحث الفردي المباشر
    app.get('/api/kiosk/lookup', async (req, res) => {
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      const rawQ = String(req.query.q || '').trim();
      if (!rawQ) return res.json({ found: false, matches: [] });

      const qLower = rawQ.toLowerCase();
      const qNorm = _normArKiosk(rawQ);
      const catalog = await _loadCatalogFromSqliteSafely();

      const matches = catalog.filter((p) => {
        const bCode = String(p.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
        const plu = String(p.plu_code || '').toLowerCase();
        const nNorm = _normArKiosk(p.name || '');
        const cNorm = _normArKiosk(p.category || '');
        return bCode === qLower || plu === qLower || nNorm.includes(qNorm) || cNorm.includes(qNorm) || bCode.includes(qLower);
      });

      if (matches.length === 0) {
        return res.json({ found: false, matches: [] });
      }
      return res.json({ found: true, product: matches[0], matches: matches.slice(0, 12) });
    });

    // 4. تقديم صفحة الكشك من الملف المستقل kiosk-client.html
    app.get('/kiosk', (_req, res) => {
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8');
      const htmlPath = require('path').join(__dirname, 'kiosk-client.html');
      if (require('fs').existsSync(htmlPath)) {
        res.send(require('fs').readFileSync(htmlPath, 'utf8'));
      } else {
        res.send('<h1>Kiosk Ready</h1>');
      }
    });
  }
