        htmlBody: `<h2 style="text-align:center;margin:0 0 12px;">إعلان وتنبيه للزبائن الكرام</h2>
<p>يسعدنا في متجرنا أن نعلن لزبائننا الأوفياء عن توفير كافة المستلزمات بأسعار تنافسية وجودة مضمونة، مع إمكانية الاستفادة من بطاقة الوفاء ونقاط التخفيض الفوري.</p>
<p><strong>شروط العمل:</strong> البضاعة المباعة تستبدل خلال 48 ساعة بشرط إحضار الوصل الأصلي وسلامة الغلاف.</p>`
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // 1. جلب أحدث الفواتير الحقيقية والمنتجات من SQLite عند الحاجة
      // ======================================================================
      async loadRealSalesIfNeeded(force = false) {
        if (!force && this.realSalesList.length > 0) return;
        try {
          const rows = window.api && typeof window.api.getSales === 'function'
            ? await window.api.getSales({})
            : [];
          if (Array.isArray(rows)) {
            this.realSalesList = rows.slice(0, 25);
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      },

      async loadRealSaleAtCursor() {
        await this.loadRealSalesIfNeeded(false);
        const head = this.realSalesList[this.realSaleIndex];
        if (!head) {
          this.realSaleDocCache = null;
          return;
        }
        try {
          const det = window.api && typeof window.api.getSaleDetails === 'function'
            ? await window.api.getSaleDetails(Number(head.id))
            : head;
          const items = det && Array.isArray(det.items)
            ? det.items.map((it) => ({
                barcode: it.product_barcode || it.barcode || '-',
                name: it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'صنف',
                unit: it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة',
                qty: Number(it.quantity ?? it.qty ?? 1),
                price: Number(it.price || 0),
                discount: Number(it.discount || 0),
                tva: Number(it.tva || 0),
                subtotal: Number(it.subtotal ?? Number(it.price || 0) * Number(it.quantity || 1))
              }))
            : [];
          const cid = Number(det?.customer_id || head.customer_id || 0);
          const total = Number(det?.total ?? head.total ?? 0);
          const paid = Number(det?.paid_amount ?? head.paid_amount ?? total);

          this.realSaleDocCache = {
            docNumber: det?.doc_number || head.doc_number || String(head.id),
            date: String(det?.sale_date || head.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()).replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16),
            customerId: cid > 0 ? cid : null,
            isWalkinCustomer: cid <= 0,
            partyTitle: 'الزبون:',
            partyName: cid > 0 ? (det?.customer_name || `زبون #${cid}`) : 'زبون عابر (Comptoir)',
            partyPhone: det?.customer_phone || '',
            partyAddress: det?.customer_address || '',
            paymentMethod: det?.payment_method === 'credit' ? 'بيع بالدين (À Terme)' : 'نقداً (Espèces)',
            items,
            subtotal: Number(det?.subtotal ?? total),
            discount: Number(det?.discount || 0),
            stampAmount: Number(det?.stamp_amount || 0),
            total,
            paidAmount: paid,
            receivedAmount: paid,
            remainingDebt: Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)))
          };
        } catch (_) {
          this.realSaleDocCache = null;
        }
      },

      async loadProductsForBarcodesIfNeeded() {
        if (this.barcodeState.products.length > 0) return;
        try {
          const prods = window.api && typeof window.api.getProducts === 'function'
            ? await window.api.getProducts({})
            : (window.AppState && Array.isArray(window.AppState.products) ? window.AppState.products : []);
          if (Array.isArray(prods)) {
            this.barcodeState.products = prods.slice(0, 300);
            if (this.barcodeState.queue.length === 0 && prods.length > 0) {
              const first = prods[0];
              this.barcodeState.queue.push({
                id: first.id,
                name: first.name || 'منتج',
                barcode: first.barcode || '6130001000012',
                price: Number(first.selling_price ?? first.price ?? 0),
                qty: 4
              });
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      },

      async loadPrintersIfAvailable() {
        if (this.availablePrinters.length > 0) return;
        try {
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getPrinters === 'function') {
            const list = await window.api.getPrinters();
            if (Array.isArray(list)) this.availablePrinters = list;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      },

      // تجهيز بيانات المعاينة بناءً على الوضع المختار (زبون عابر / زبون وفي / آخر فاتورة حقيقية)
      getPreviewDocDataFor(docId) {
        const meta = PSP.state.getDocMeta(docId);
        const mode = PSP.state.previewMode || 'VIP';
        const base = PSP.utils.deepClone(meta.sampleData || {});

        if (mode === 'WALKIN') {
          return {
            ...base,
            _previewMode: 'WALKIN',
            customerId: null,
            isWalkinCustomer: true,
            partyTitle: 'الزبون:',
            partyName: 'زبون عابر (Comptoir)',
            partyPhone: '',
            partyAddress: '',
            previousBalance: 0,
            loyaltyTotalBalance: 0,
            loyaltyPointsEarned: 0,
            loyaltyPointsUsed: 0,
            paidAmount: base.total || 0,
            receivedAmount: base.receivedAmount || base.total || 0,
            remainingDebt: 0
          };
        }

        if (mode === 'REAL_SALE' && this.realSaleDocCache) {
          return PSP.utils.deepClone(this.realSaleDocCache);
        }

        return {
          ...base,
          _previewMode: 'VIP'
        };
      },

      // ======================================================================

      // ======================================================================
      // 3. الشاشة الأولى: معرض الـ 34 مستنداً (Zoho Books Style)

      buildGalleryCardsHtml() {

        const q = (this.gallerySearch || '').trim().toLowerCase();

          if (cat !== 'ALL' && d.cat !== cat) return false;
          if (q && !`${d.num} ${d.name} ${d.cleanTitle} ${d.sourceLabel} ${d.proDesc} ${d.id}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        });

        if (filtered.length === 0) {
          return `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:42px;color:var(--psp-text-muted);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;">لا توجد مستندات مطابقة للبحث "${esc(this.gallerySearch)}"</div>`;

                    <button type="button" class="psp-pill-btn ${tpl.logoAlign === 'left' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="tpl-pill" data-field="logoAlign" data-val="left">يسار</button>

              <div class="psp-field">

              <div class="psp-grid-2">

          const renderSecRow = (sec) => {

            const isExp = this.expandedSectionId === sec.id;
            const catInfo = PSP.state.SECTIONS_CATALOG.find((c) => c.id === sec.id);

      buildStudioViewHtml() {

        const rendered = PSP.renderer.renderDocument(tpl, docData, 'preview', { zoomPct: zoom });

        const realBadge = this.realSalesList.length > 0
          ? `#${this.realSalesList[this.realSaleIndex]?.doc_number || this.realSalesList[this.realSaleIndex]?.id}`
          : 'حقيقية';

        return `

      // ======================================================================
      // 5. الشاشة الثالثة: استوديو ملصقات الباركود والرفوف
      // ======================================================================
      buildBarcodePreviewHtml() {
        const bs = this.barcodeState;
        const shop = PSP.state.getShopIdentity();
        const dimMap = {
          '40x25': { w: '40mm', h: '25mm', barH: 26, font: '9px', priceFont: '11px' },
          '50x30': { w: '50mm', h: '30mm', barH: 32, font: '10px', priceFont: '13px' },
          '60x40': { w: '60mm', h: '40mm', barH: 38, font: '11px', priceFont: '15px' },
          'a4':    { w: '48mm', h: '28mm', barH: 28, font: '9.5px', priceFont: '12px' }
        };
        const d = dimMap[bs.size] || dimMap['40x25'];
        const labels = [];

        for (const item of bs.queue) {
          const count = Math.min(60, Math.max(1, Number(item.qty || 1)));
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            labels.push(`
              <div class="psp-barcode-card" style="width:${d.w};min-height:${d.h};font-size:${d.font};">
                ${bs.showShop ? `<div style="font-weight:900;font-size:8.5px;color:#334155;">${esc(shop.name)}</div>` : ''}
                ${bs.showName ? `<div style="font-weight:900;line-height:1.2;max-height:2.4em;overflow:hidden;">${esc(item.name)}</div>` : ''}
                ${buildBarcodeSvg(item.barcode, d.barH)}
                ${bs.showCodeText ? `<div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:800;">${esc(item.barcode)}</div>` : ''}
                ${bs.showPrice ? `<div style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:900;font-size:${d.priceFont};color:#0f172a;">${Number(item.price || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج${bs.showCentimes ? ` <span style="font-size:8px;color:#475569;">(${fmtCentimes(item.price)})</span>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
              </div>`);
          }
        }

        if (labels.length === 0) {
          return `<div style="color:var(--psp-text-muted);font-weight:800;padding:40px;text-align:center;">أضف منتجات من القائمة اليمنى لمعاينة وطباعة الملصقات</div>`;
        }
        return `<div class="psp-barcode-sheet">${labels.join('')}</div>`;
      },

          .slice(0, 25);

        return `

                    <button type="button" class="psp-pill-btn ${bs.size === '50x30' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="bc-size" data-val="50x30">50×30</button>

                <div class="psp-card">
                  <div class="psp-card-title"><span>🔍 إضافة منتجات للطابور</span></div>
                  <input type="text" class="psp-input" value="${esc(bs.search)}" placeholder="ابحث بالاسم أو الباركود..." data-psp-input="bc-search">
                  <div style="max-height:175px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;">
                    ${filteredProds.map((p) => `
                      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--psp-surface);border:1px solid var(--psp-border);border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;">
                        <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
                          <div style="font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${esc(p.name)}</div>
                          <div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--psp-text-muted);">${esc(p.barcode || '-')} • ${Number(p.selling_price ?? p.price ?? 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" class="psp-mini-btn is-active" data-psp-act="bc-add" data-id="${p.id}">+ إضافة</button>
                      </div>`).join('')}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="psp-card">
                  <div class="psp-card-title">
                    <span>🖨️ طابور الطباعة (${bs.queue.reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.qty || 1), 0)} ملصق)</span>
                    ${bs.queue.length > 0 ? `<button type="button" class="psp-mini-btn" data-psp-act="bc-clear">تفريغ</button>` : ''}
                  </div>
                  <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;max-height:150px;overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${bs.queue.map((qItem, idx) => `
                      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--psp-surface);border:1px solid var(--psp-border);border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex:1;">${esc(qItem.name)}</span>
                        <input type="number" min="1" max="100" value="${qItem.qty}" style="width:48px;height:26px;text-align:center;" class="psp-input" data-psp-input="bc-qty" data-idx="${idx}">
                        <button type="button" class="psp-mini-btn" data-psp-act="bc-remove" data-idx="${idx}">✕</button>
                      </div>`).join('') || '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--psp-text-muted);text-align:center;">الطابور فارغ</div>'}
                  </div>
                  <div class="psp-grid-2" style="margin-top:4px;">
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn psp-btn-primary" data-psp-act="bc-print">🖨️ طباعة الملصقات</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" data-psp-act="bc-pdf">📄 تصدير PDF</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </aside>

            <div class="psp-desk-wrap">
              <div class="psp-desk-scroll" id="pspBarcodeDeskHost">
                ${this.buildBarcodePreviewHtml()}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // 6. الشاشة الرابعة: محرر الوثائق والبونات الحر (Word)
      // ======================================================================
      buildWordEditorViewHtml() {
        const ws = this.wordState;
        const shop = PSP.state.getShopIdentity();
        const widthCss = ws.paperSize === '80mm' ? '80mm' : ws.paperSize === 'a5' ? '148mm' : '210mm';

        return `
          <div class="psp-sub-workspace">
            <aside class="psp-sidebar">
              <div class="psp-sidebar-body">
                <div class="psp-card">
                  <div class="psp-card-title"><span>📐 إعدادات الوثيقة الحرة</span></div>
                  <div class="psp-pill-row">
                    <button type="button" class="psp-pill-btn ${ws.paperSize === 'a4' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="word-size" data-val="a4">A4</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-pill-btn ${ws.paperSize === 'a5' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="word-size" data-val="a5">A5</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-pill-btn ${ws.paperSize === '80mm' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="word-size" data-val="80mm">80mm</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="psp-col-row">
                    <span style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;">إدراج ترويسة المتجر الرسمية</span>
                    <label class="psp-switch"><input type="checkbox" ${ws.includeShopHeader ? 'checked' : ''} data-psp-change="word-header"><span class="psp-switch-track"></span></label>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="psp-card">
                  <div class="psp-card-title"><span>✍️ أدوات التنسيق</span></div>
                  <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;">
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px;" data-psp-act="word-cmd" data-val="bold"><b>B</b> عريض</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px;" data-psp-act="word-cmd" data-val="underline"><u>U</u> تسطير</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px;" data-psp-act="word-cmd" data-val="justifyRight">يمين</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px;" data-psp-act="word-cmd" data-val="justifyCenter">وسط</button>
                    <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="height:30px;padding:0 10px;" data-psp-act="word-cmd" data-val="insertUnorderedList">• قائمة</button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="psp-card">
                  <div class="psp-card-title"><span>📋 نماذج جاهزة بضغطة زر</span></div>
                  <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="justify-content:flex-start;" data-psp-act="word-preset" data-val="promo">📢 إعلان تخفيضات للزبائن</button>
                  <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="justify-content:flex-start;" data-psp-act="word-preset" data-val="debt_ack">📝 التزام واعتراف بدين</button>
                  <button type="button" class="psp-btn" style="justify-content:flex-start;" data-psp-act="word-preset" data-val="receipt_free">💵 وصل استلام مبلغ حر</button>
                </div>

                <div class="psp-grid-2">
                  <button type="button" class="psp-btn psp-btn-primary" data-psp-act="word-print">🖨️ طباعة الآن</button>
                  <button type="button" class="psp-btn" data-psp-act="word-pdf">📄 تصدير PDF</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </aside>

            <div class="psp-desk-wrap">
              <div class="psp-desk-scroll">
                <div style="width:${widthCss};max-width:100%;background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a;box-shadow:var(--psp-shadow-paper);padding:${ws.paperSize === '80mm' ? '4mm' : '12mm'};direction:rtl;" id="pspWordPrintablePaper">
                  ${ws.includeShopHeader ? `
                    <div style="text-align:center;border-bottom:2px solid #0f172a;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:14px;">
                      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:900;">${esc(shop.name)}</div>
                      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#475569;font-weight:700;">${esc(shop.address)}${shop.phone ? ` | ${esc(shop.phone)}` : ''}</div>
                    </div>` : ''}
                  <div id="pspWordEditableArea" contenteditable="true" spellcheck="false" style="min-height:140mm;outline:none;line-height:1.75;font-size:13px;">${ws.htmlBody}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // 7. التحديث الجراحي اللحظي (<16ms — بدون إعادة رسم الصفحة أو فقدان التركيز)
      // ======================================================================
      updatePaperOnly() {
        if (this._rafPaper) return;
        this._rafPaper = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          this._rafPaper = false;
          const host = document.getElementById('pspPaperHost');
          if (!host) return;
          const tpl = PSP.state.getActiveTemplate();
          const docData = this.getPreviewDocDataFor(tpl.id);
          const rendered = PSP.renderer.renderDocument(tpl, docData, 'preview', { zoomPct: PSP.state.zoomPct });
          host.innerHTML = rendered.paperHtml;
        });
      },

      updateSidebarOnly() {
        const bodyHost = document.getElementById('pspSidebarBodyHost');
        if (!bodyHost) return;
        const prevScroll = bodyHost.scrollTop;
        bodyHost.innerHTML = this.buildSidebarBodyHtml();
        bodyHost.scrollTop = prevScroll;

        const tab = PSP.state.activeSidebarTab || 'identity';
        document.querySelectorAll('#pspSideTabsHost .psp-side-tab').forEach((b) => {
          b.classList.toggle('is-active', b.getAttribute('data-val') === tab);
        });
      },

      updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills() {
        const h = PSP.state.getHistoryInfo();
        const uBtn = document.getElementById('pspUndoBtn');
        const rBtn = document.getElementById('pspRedoBtn');
        const cnt = document.getElementById('pspHistCounter');
        if (uBtn) uBtn.disabled = !h.canUndo;
        if (rBtn) rBtn.disabled = !h.canRedo;
        if (cnt) cnt.textContent = `${h.index + 1}/${h.total}`;

        const tpl = PSP.state.getActiveTemplate();
        document.querySelectorAll('#pspTopbarHost [data-psp-act="set-paper"]').forEach((b) => {
          b.classList.toggle('is-active', b.getAttribute('data-val') === tpl.paperSize);
        });
      },

      updateFloatingBarOnly() {
        const bar = document.getElementById('pspFloatingBarHost');
        if (!bar) return;
        const pMode = PSP.state.previewMode || 'VIP';
        const zoom = Number(PSP.state.zoomPct || 100);
        const realBadge = this.realSalesList.length > 0
          ? `#${this.realSalesList[this.realSaleIndex]?.doc_number || this.realSalesList[this.realSaleIndex]?.id}`
          : 'حقيقية';

        bar.innerHTML = `
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${pMode === 'WALKIN' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-preview-mode" data-val="WALKIN">🚶 زبون عابر</button>
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${pMode === 'VIP' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-preview-mode" data-val="VIP">👑 زبون وفي</button>
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${pMode === 'REAL_SALE' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-preview-mode" data-val="REAL_SALE">🆕 آخر فاتورة ${pMode === 'REAL_SALE' ? `(${esc(realBadge)})` : ''}</button>
          ${pMode === 'REAL_SALE' && this.realSalesList.length > 1 ? `
            <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn" style="padding:0 6px;" data-psp-act="real-sale-step" data-val="1" title="الأقدم">◀</button>
            <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn" style="padding:0 6px;" data-psp-act="real-sale-step" data-val="-1" title="الأحدث">▶</button>
          ` : ''}
          <span class="psp-float-sep"></span>
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${zoom === 75 ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-zoom" data-val="75">75%</button>
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${zoom === 100 ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-zoom" data-val="100">100%</button>
          <button type="button" class="psp-float-btn ${zoom === 125 ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-psp-act="set-zoom" data-val="125">125%</button>
        `;
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // 8. التركيب الشامل وتفويض الأحداث (Event Delegation)
      // ======================================================================
      renderFull() {
        const rootEl = this._mountEl || PSP.getMountRoot();
        if (!rootEl) return;

        const view = PSP.state.activeView || 'gallery';
        let bodyHtml = '';
        if (view === 'gallery') bodyHtml = this.buildGalleryViewHtml();
        else if (view === 'studio') bodyHtml = this.buildStudioViewHtml();
        else if (view === 'barcodes') bodyHtml = this.buildBarcodesViewHtml();
        else bodyHtml = this.buildWordEditorViewHtml();

        rootEl.innerHTML = `
          <div class="psp-root" id="pspStudioAppRoot" data-gherbi-print-v2="1" data-psp-studio="1">
            ${this.buildTopbarHtml()}
            ${bodyHtml}
          </div>`;

        this.bindDelegatedEvents(rootEl.querySelector('#pspStudioAppRoot'));
      },

      mount(rootEl) {
        this._mountEl = rootEl || PSP.getMountRoot();
        PSP.state.ensureAllTemplatesInitialized();
        this.loadPrintersIfAvailable();
        this.renderFull();
      },

      openDocInStudio(docId) {
        PSP.state.activeView = 'studio';
        PSP.state.setActiveDoc(docId);
        this.expandedSectionId = null;
        this.showOptionalSections = false;
        if (PSP.isPrintViewActive()) {
          this.renderFull();
        } else if (window.App && typeof window.App.switchView === 'function') {
          window.App.switchView('print');
        }
      },

      bindDelegatedEvents(appRoot) {
        if (!appRoot || this._delegatedRoot === appRoot) return;
        this._delegatedRoot = appRoot;

        // 1) النقرات (Clicks)
        appRoot.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
          const btn = e.target.closest('[data-psp-act]');
          if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
          const act = btn.getAttribute('data-psp-act');
          const val = btn.getAttribute('data-val');
          const docId = btn.getAttribute('data-doc');
          const secId = btn.getAttribute('data-sec');
          const field = btn.getAttribute('data-field');

          if (act === 'switch-view') {
            PSP.state.activeView = val || 'gallery';
            if (val === 'barcodes') await this.loadProductsForBarcodesIfNeeded();
            if (val === 'studio' && PSP.state.historyStack.length === 0) PSP.state.pushHistory('فتح المصمم');
            this.renderFull();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'gallery-cat') {
            this.galleryCategory = val || 'ALL';
            const grid = document.getElementById('pspGalleryGridHost');
            if (grid) grid.innerHTML = this.buildGalleryCardsHtml();
            document.querySelectorAll('#pspGalleryCatsHost .psp-cat-pill').forEach((p) => {
              p.classList.toggle('is-active', p.getAttribute('data-val') === this.galleryCategory);
            });
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'gallery-customize') {
            this.openDocInStudio(docId);
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'gallery-test-print') {
            const tpl = PSP.state.getTemplate(docId);
            const rendered = PSP.renderer.renderDocument(tpl, this.getPreviewDocDataFor(docId), 'print');
            await dispatchPrintOrPdf(rendered.fullHtml, rendered.paperSize, false, docId);
            toast('🖨️ تم إرسال الطباعة التجريبية بنجاح!');
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'gallery-reset-doc') {
            PSP.state.resetTemplateToDefault(docId);
            const grid = document.getElementById('pspGalleryGridHost');
            if (grid) grid.innerHTML = this.buildGalleryCardsHtml();
            toast('↺ تمت استعادة القالب الافتراضي (Par Défaut).');
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'reset-all-defaults') {
            PSP.state.resetAllTemplatesToDefault();
            this.renderFull();
            toast('⚡ تم اعتماد القوالب الافتراضية المثالية لجميع الـ 34 مستنداً!');
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'prev-doc' || act === 'next-doc') {
            const docs = PSP.state.getTemplatesRegistry();
            const curIdx = docs.findIndex((d) => d.id === PSP.state.activeDocId);
            const delta = act === 'prev-doc' ? -1 : 1;
            const nextDoc = docs[(curIdx + delta + docs.length) % docs.length];
            if (nextDoc) {
              PSP.state.setActiveDoc(nextDoc.id);
              this.expandedSectionId = null;
              this.showOptionalSections = false;
              this.renderFull();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'set-paper') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              t.paperSize = val;
              t.densityMode = val === '80mm' || val === '58mm' ? 'compact' : 'normal';
              t.borderMode = val === '80mm' || val === '58mm' ? 'dashed' : 'grid';
              t.showAmountInWords = !(val === '80mm' || val === '58mm');
              t.showFiscalIds = !(val === '80mm' || val === '58mm');
            }, `تغيير المقاس (${val})`);
            this.updateTopbarAndPaper();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'undo') {
            if (PSP.state.undo()) {
              this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
              this.updateSidebarOnly();
              this.updatePaperOnly();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'redo') {
            if (PSP.state.redo()) {
              this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
              this.updateSidebarOnly();
              this.updatePaperOnly();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'save-template') {
            await PSP.state.saveToDatabase(true);
            const meta = PSP.state.getDocMeta(PSP.state.activeDocId);
            toast(`✅ تم حفظ واعتماد القالب (${meta.name}) في قاعدة البيانات!`);
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'print-current' || act === 'pdf-current') {
            const tpl = PSP.state.getActiveTemplate();
            const mode = act === 'pdf-current' ? 'pdf' : 'print';
            const rendered = PSP.renderer.renderDocument(tpl, this.getPreviewDocDataFor(tpl.id), mode);
            await dispatchPrintOrPdf(rendered.fullHtml, rendered.paperSize, act === 'pdf-current', tpl.id);
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'side-tab') {
            PSP.state.activeSidebarTab = val || 'identity';
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'set-theme') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => { t.themeId = val; }, 'تغيير الثيم اللوني');
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'font-dec' || act === 'font-inc') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              const cur = Number(t.baseFontSizePx || 12);
              t.baseFontSizePx = Math.max(8.5, Math.min(18, Number((cur + (act === 'font-inc' ? 0.5 : -0.5)).toFixed(1))));
            }, 'حجم الخط');
            const lbl = document.getElementById('pspFontValLbl');
            if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${PSP.state.getActiveTemplate().baseFontSizePx}px`;
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'tpl-pill') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => { t[field] = val; }, `تعديل ${field}`);
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'expand-section') {
            this.expandedSectionId = this.expandedSectionId === secId ? null : secId;
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'toggle-optional-secs') {
            this.showOptionalSections = !this.showOptionalSections;
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'move-sec-up' || act === 'move-sec-down') {
            const delta = act === 'move-sec-up' ? -1 : 1;
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              const arr = t.sections || [];
              const idx = arr.findIndex((s) => s.id === secId);
              const next = idx + delta;
              if (idx >= 0 && next >= 0 && next < arr.length) {
                const tmp = arr[idx]; arr[idx] = arr[next]; arr[next] = tmp;
              }
            }, 'ترتيب الأقسام');
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'sec-pill') {
            const parsedVal = field === 'fontScale' ? Number(val) : val;
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              const sec = (t.sections || []).find((s) => s.id === secId);
              if (sec) sec[field] = parsedVal;
            }, 'تنسيق قسم');
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'insert-var') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              const sec = (t.sections || []).find((s) => s.id === secId);
              if (sec) sec.note = ((sec.note || '') + ' ' + val).trim();
            }, 'إدراج متغير');
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'reset-sec') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              const sec = (t.sections || []).find((s) => s.id === secId);
              if (sec) {
                sec.title = ''; sec.note = ''; sec.align = 'right';
                sec.fontScale = 100; sec.border = 'default'; sec.bg = 'default';
              }
            }, 'ضبط قسم');
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'col-preset') {
            const presets = {
              thermal_simple: { index: false, barcode: false, name: true, unit: false, qty: true, unitPrice: true, discount: false, tva: false, subtotal: true },
              alt_d_credit:   { index: true,  barcode: false, name: true, unit: true,  qty: true, unitPrice: true, discount: false, tva: false, subtotal: true },
              alt_h_history:  { index: true,  barcode: true,  name: true, unit: true,  qty: true, unitPrice: true, discount: false, tva: false, subtotal: true },
              z_report:       { index: false, barcode: false, name: true, unit: false, qty: false, unitPrice: false, discount: false, tva: false, subtotal: true },
              a4_full:        { index: true,  barcode: true,  name: true, unit: true,  qty: true, unitPrice: true, discount: true,  tva: true,  subtotal: true },
              bl_qty_only:    { index: true,  barcode: true,  name: true, unit: true,  qty: true, unitPrice: false, discount: false, tva: false, subtotal: false }
            };
            if (presets[val]) {
              PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => { t.columns = { ...presets[val] }; }, 'قالب أعمدة');
              this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
              this.updateSidebarOnly();
              this.updatePaperOnly();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'set-lang') {
            PSP.state.mutateActiveTemplate((t) => {
              t.lang = val;
              t.columnLabels = PSP.utils.deepClone(PSP.state.DEFAULT_COLUMN_LABELS[val] || PSP.state.DEFAULT_COLUMN_LABELS.ar);
            }, `اللغة (${val})`);
            this.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            this.updateSidebarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'reset-active-doc') {
            PSP.state.resetTemplateToDefault(PSP.state.activeDocId);
            this.expandedSectionId = null;
            this.renderFull();
            toast('↺ تمت استعادة التصميم الافتراضي (Par Défaut).');
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'set-zoom') {
            PSP.state.zoomPct = Number(val || 100);
            this.updateFloatingBarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'set-preview-mode') {
            PSP.state.previewMode = val || 'VIP';
            if (val === 'REAL_SALE') {
              await this.loadRealSaleAtCursor();
            }
            this.updateFloatingBarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          if (act === 'real-sale-step') {
            const delta = Number(val || 0);
            this.realSaleIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.realSalesList.length - 1, this.realSaleIndex + delta));
            await this.loadRealSaleAtCursor();
            this.updateFloatingBarOnly();
            this.updatePaperOnly();
            return;
          }

          // أحداث تبويب الباركود
          if (act === 'bc-size') {
            this.barcodeState.size = val;
            this.renderFull();
            return;
          }
          if (act === 'bc-add') {
            const pid = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-id'));
            const prod = this.barcodeState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === pid);
            if (prod) {
              const ex = this.barcodeState.queue.find((q) => Number(q.id) === pid);
              if (ex) ex.qty = Number(ex.qty || 1) + 1;
              else this.barcodeState.queue.push({ id: prod.id, name: prod.name, barcode: prod.barcode || String(prod.id), price: Number(prod.selling_price ?? prod.price ?? 0), qty: 2 });
              this.renderFull();
            }
            return;
          }
          if (act === 'bc-remove') {
            const idx = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-idx'));
            this.barcodeState.queue.splice(idx, 1);
            this.renderFull();
            return;
          }
          if (act === 'bc-clear') {
            this.barcodeState.queue = [];
            this.renderFull();
            return;
          }
          if (act === 'bc-print' || act === 'bc-pdf') {
            const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><style>@page{margin:4mm;}body{margin:0;font-family:'Cairo',Tahoma,sans-serif;direction:rtl;}.psp-barcode-sheet{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;}.psp-barcode-card{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;padding:4px 6px;text-align:center;page-break-inside:avoid;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}</style></head><body>${this.buildBarcodePreviewHtml()}</body></html>`;
            await dispatchPrintOrPdf(html, this.barcodeState.size === 'a4' ? 'a4' : '80mm', act === 'bc-pdf', 'barcode_labels');
            return;
          }

          // أحداث تبويب المحرر الحر (Word)

            return;

              receipt_free: `<h2 style="text-align:center;">💵 وصل استلام مبلغ نقدي</h2><p>بتاريخ: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}</p><p>استلمنا من السيد(ة): ........................................ مبلغاً وقدره: <strong>.................... د.ج</strong></p><p>وذلك مقابل: ........................................................................</p><p style="margin-top:30px;">توقيع وختم المستلم: ................................</p>`

            this.renderFull();
          }
        });

    if (!window._pspKeyboardUndoBound) {
      window._pspKeyboardUndoBound = true;
      window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (!PSP.isPrintViewActive() || PSP.state.activeView !== 'studio') return;
        const tag = e.target && e.target.tagName;
        if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || (e.target && e.target.isContentEditable)) return;

        const key = String(e.key || '').toLowerCase();
        if (e.ctrlKey && !e.shiftKey && key === 'z') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (PSP.state.undo()) {
            UI.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            UI.updateSidebarOnly();
            UI.updatePaperOnly();
          }
        } else if ((e.ctrlKey && key === 'y') || (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && key === 'z')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (PSP.state.redo()) {
            UI.updateUndoRedoAndTopbarPills();
            UI.updateSidebarOnly();
            UI.updatePaperOnly();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    PSP.ui = UI;
    PSP.modules.ui = true;
    PSP.stage = Math.max(PSP.stage || 1, 4);

    if (PSP.isPrintViewActive()) {
      PSP.mount();
    }

    console.log('✅ [Print Studio Pro — Stage 4/UI]: الواجهة العالمية (معرض الـ 34 + المصمم البصري + الباركود + المحرر الحر) جاهزة 100%.');
  })();

    console.log('✅ 1/4: تم ربط قناة redeemCustomerLoyaltyPoints في preload.js.');
  }

const srvPath = path.join(ROOT, 'server.js');
if (fs.existsSync(srvPath)) {

// ============================================================================
// 3. تصفير الـ 121 نقطة التي استُعملت في الفاتورة السابقة داخل قاعدة البيانات الحية
// ============================================================================
function zeroRedeemedPointsInLiveDb() {
  const candidates = new Set([
    path.join(ROOT, 'data', 'gherbi_ai_pos.db'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db')
  ]);
  const appData = process.env.APPDATA || '';
  if (appData && fs.existsSync(appData)) {
    try {
      for (const d of fs.readdirSync(appData, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (d.isDirectory() && /gherbi|electron/i.test(d.name)) {
          candidates.add(path.join(appData, d.name, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db'));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const files = Array.from(candidates).filter((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
  return Promise.all(
    files.map(
      (dbFile) =>
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          const liveDb = new sqlite3.Database(dbFile, (err) => {
            if (err) return resolve();
            liveDb.serialize(() => {
              liveDb.run('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 8000');
              liveDb.run("UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = 0 WHERE loyalty_points >= 120 AND deleted_at IS NULL");
            });
            liveDb.close(() => {
              console.log(`  ✅ تم تصفير النقاط المستعملة في قاعدة البيانات الحية: ${dbFile}`);
              resolve();
            });
          });
        })
    )
  );
}

function installLoyaltyZeroBalanceOnRedeemV23() {

    if (pts >= 100) return { label: '🥇 عضو ذهبي Gold', cls: 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950' };
    if (pts >= 30) return { label: '🥈 عضو فضي Silver', cls: 'bg-slate-300 text-slate-900' };

  App.renderPosLoyaltySmartBar = function () {

    var netTotal = Math.max(0, rawSubtotal - curDiscount);

    var originalPts = Math.max(0, Number(cust.loyalty_points || 0));
    var alreadyRedeemedPts = Math.min(originalPts, Math.max(0, Number((this.currentCart && this.currentCart.redeemedLoyaltyPoints) || 0)));
    var alreadyRedeemedDzd = Number((this.currentCart && this.currentCart.redeemedLoyaltyDiscountDzd) || 0);

    var centimeVal = typeof this.formatAlgerianCentimes === 'function' ? this.formatAlgerianCentimes(remainingPtsValueDzd) : '';

    var tierInfo = getRetailTierInfoV23(originalPts);
    var fidCode = typeof this.getCustomerCardBarcode === 'function' ? this.getCustomerCardBarcode(cust) : ('FID-' + String(cust.id).padStart(5, '0'));
    var possibleDiscountNow = Math.min(rawSubtotal, Number((originalPts * ptValueDzd).toFixed(2)));

      '  </div>' +

  // 2) اعتراض window.api.processSale لضمان خصم النقاط المستعملة وتثبيت الرصيد الجديد (0 نقطة) في قاعدة البيانات 100%
  if (window.api && typeof window.api.processSale === 'function' && !window.api._loyaltyV23Hooked) {
    var _baseProcessSaleV23 = window.api.processSale.bind(window.api);
    window.api._loyaltyV23Hooked = true;

    window.api.processSale = async function (salePayload) {
      var cart = App.currentCart || {};
      var cid = Number((salePayload && salePayload.customer_id) || cart.customerId || document.getElementById('posCustomerSelect')?.value || 0);
      var redeemedPts = Math.max(0, Number(cart.redeemedLoyaltyPoints || 0));
      var cust = cid ? (AppState.customers || []).find(function (c) { return Number(c.id) === cid; }) : null;
      var preSalePts = cust ? Math.max(0, Number(cust.loyalty_points || 0)) : 0;

      var ptsRate = Math.max(0.1, Number(AppState.loyaltyPointsPer100Dzd || 1));
      var tot = Math.max(0, Number((salePayload && salePayload.total) || 0));
      var earnedPts = redeemedPts > 0 ? 0 : Math.floor((tot / 100) * ptsRate);

      if (salePayload && typeof salePayload === 'object') {
        salePayload.customer_id = cid || null;
        salePayload.loyalty_points_per_100_dzd = ptsRate;
        salePayload.redeemed_loyalty_points = redeemedPts;
        salePayload.earned_loyalty_points = earnedPts;
      }

      var res = await _baseProcessSaleV23(salePayload);

      // تحديث قاطع لرصيد نقاط الزبون في قاعدة البيانات عبر updateCustomer (حتى لو لم يُعد تشغيل Electron!)
      if (cid && cust && window.api.updateCustomer) {
        var finalPoints = redeemedPts > 0
          ? Math.max(0, preSalePts - redeemedPts)
          : (preSalePts + earnedPts);

        cust.loyalty_points = finalPoints;
        await window.api.updateCustomer(cid, Object.assign({}, cust, {
          loyalty_points: finalPoints
        })).catch(function () {});
      }

      if (App.currentCart) {
        App.currentCart.redeemedLoyaltyPoints = 0;
        App.currentCart.redeemedLoyaltyDiscountDzd = 0;
      }

      return res;
    };
  }

  // تحديث فوري للبيانات والواجهة
  setTimeout(async function () {
    if (window.api && window.api.getCustomers) {
      AppState.customers = (await window.api.getCustomers().catch(function () { return []; })) || [];
    }
    if (AppState.currentView === 'pos') App.renderPosView();
    else if (AppState.currentView === 'customers') App.renderCustomersView();
  }, 200);
}

function restoreIndexHtml() {
  // 1. إذا كانت النسخة الاحتياطية الأولى موجودة، نستعيدها فوراً لأنها تطابق شاشتك الأولى 100%
  if (fs.existsSync(BAK_INDEX_1)) {
    fs.copyFileSync(BAK_INDEX_1, INDEX_PATH);
    console.log('✅ تم استرجاع index.html الأصلي من النسخة الاحتياطية الأولى (.bak_before_sds_fusion).');
    return;
  }

  // 2. إذا كانت النسخة الاحتياطية الثانية موجودة ولا تحتوي على تعديلات SDS، نستعيدها
  if (fs.existsSync(BAK_INDEX_2)) {
    const bak2Content = fs.readFileSync(BAK_INDEX_2, 'utf8');
    if (!bak2Content.includes('pos-sds-fusion-section') && !bak2Content.includes('sds-pos-master-view')) {
      fs.copyFileSync(BAK_INDEX_2, INDEX_PATH);
      console.log('✅ تم استرجاع index.html الأصلي من النسخة الاحتياطية (.bak_sds_modern).');
      return;
    }
  }

  // 3. استعادة جراحية نظيفة في حال عدم وجود ملفات النسخ الاحتياطي
  if (fs.existsSync(INDEX_PATH)) {
    let html = fs.readFileSync(INDEX_PATH, 'utf8');

    // إزالة النوافذ المضافة الخاصة بـ SDS
    html = html.replace(/<!-- =================================================================\s*نافذة بطاقة الزبون الشاملة[\s\S]*?(?=<section id="view-sales")/g, '');

    // إرجاع قسم #view-pos الأصلي
    html = html.replace(/<section id="view-pos"[\s\S]*?<\/section>/, ORIGINAL_POS_SECTION);

    // إزالة السكربتات المضافة
    html = html.replace(/\s*<script src="\.\/pos-sds-pro-fusion\.js"><\/script>/g, '');
    html = html.replace(/\s*<script src="\.\/sds-modern-pos-engine\.js"><\/script>/g, '');

    fs.writeFileSync(INDEX_PATH, html, 'utf8');
    console.log('✅ تم تنظيف وإرجاع هيكل index.html الأصلي بنجاح.');
  }
}

function restoreStylesCss() {
  if (fs.existsSync(BAK_STYLES_1)) {
    fs.copyFileSync(BAK_STYLES_1, STYLES_PATH);
    console.log('✅ تم استرجاع styles.css الأصلي من النسخة الاحتياطية الأولى (.bak_before_sds_fusion).');
    return;
  }

  if (fs.existsSync(BAK_STYLES_2)) {
    const bak2Css = fs.readFileSync(BAK_STYLES_2, 'utf8');
    if (!bak2Css.includes('GHERBI.AI POS + SDS ERGONOMIC FUSION')) {
      fs.copyFileSync(BAK_STYLES_2, STYLES_PATH);
      console.log('✅ تم استرجاع styles.css الأصلي من النسخة الاحتياطية (.bak_sds_modern).');
      return;
    }
  }

  if (fs.existsSync(STYLES_PATH)) {
    let css = fs.readFileSync(STYLES_PATH, 'utf8');

    // حذف بلوكات CSS التي أضيفت في التعديلين الأول والثاني
    const idx1 = css.indexOf('/* ==========================================================================\n   GHERBI.AI POS + SDS ERGONOMIC FUSION');
    if (idx1 !== -1) css = css.slice(0, idx1).trim() + '\n';

    const idx2 = css.indexOf('/* ==========================================================================\n   SDS COM 1:1 REPLICA');
    if (idx2 !== -1) css = css.slice(0, idx2).trim() + '\n';

    fs.writeFileSync(STYLES_PATH, css, 'utf8');
    console.log('✅ تم تنظيف وإرجاع ملف styles.css الأصلي بنجاح.');
  }
}

function removeAddedFiles() {
  const extraFiles = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'pos-sds-pro-fusion.js'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'sds-modern-pos-engine.js'),
    BAK_INDEX_1,
    BAK_INDEX_2,
    BAK_STYLES_1,
    BAK_STYLES_2
  ];

  for (const file of extraFiles) {
    if (fs.existsSync(file)) {
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(file);
        console.log('🗑️ تم حذف الملف المؤقت:', path.basename(file));
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }
}

function syncLiveDatabaseV25() {
  const candidates = new Set([
    path.join(ROOT, 'data', 'gherbi_ai_pos.db'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db')
  ]);
  const appData = process.env.APPDATA || '';
  if (appData && fs.existsSync(appData)) {
    try {
      for (const d of fs.readdirSync(appData, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (d.isDirectory() && /gherbi|electron/i.test(d.name)) {
          candidates.add(path.join(appData, d.name, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db'));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const files = Array.from(candidates).filter((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
  return Promise.all(
    files.map(
      (dbFile) =>
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          const liveDb = new sqlite3.Database(dbFile, (err) => {
            if (err) return resolve();
            liveDb.serialize(() => {
              liveDb.run('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 8000');
              liveDb.run('ALTER TABLE sale_items ADD COLUMN bonus_qty REAL DEFAULT 0', () => {});
              liveDb.run('ALTER TABLE sale_items ADD COLUMN pack_count REAL DEFAULT 0', () => {});
              liveDb.run('ALTER TABLE sale_items ADD COLUMN pack_multiplier REAL DEFAULT 1', () => {});
              liveDb.run('ALTER TABLE sale_items ADD COLUMN sold_m2 REAL DEFAULT 0', () => {});
              liveDb.run("UPDATE customers SET name = REPLACE(name, '(زبون جملة)', '(زبون وفي)'), price_tier = 'retail' WHERE name LIKE '%زبون جملة%' OR price_tier = 'wholesale'", () => {});
            });
            liveDb.close(() => resolve());
          });
        })
    )
  );
}

  App.finalizeCustomerLoyaltyAfterSale = async function (customerId, origPtsBeforeSale, redeemedPts, saleTotalDzd) {

      ? Math.max(0, basePts - redeemedPts)
      : (basePts + earnedPts);

      loyalty_points: targetFinalPts

==================== FILE: assets/js/numberToWords.js (11.6 KB) ====================
/**
 * assets/js/numberToWords.js
 * محرك التفقيط المالي (Financial Number to Words Engine) لـ Gherbi.Ai POS
 * يدعم: العربية (بقواعد النحو للإفراد والتثنية والجمع)، الفرنسية، والإنجليزية.
 * مخصص خصيصاً للعملة الجزائرية (الدينار والسنتيم).
 */

'use strict';

const NumberToWords = (function () {
    // ============================================================================
    // 1. القاموس العربي (Arabic Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const arUnits = ["", "واحد", "اثنان", "ثلاثة", "أربعة", "خمسة", "ستة", "سبعة", "ثمانية", "تسعة"];
    const arTeens = ["عشرة", "أحد عشر", "اثنا عشر", "ثلاثة عشر", "أربعة عشر", "خمسة عشر", "ستة عشر", "سبعة عشر", "ثمانية عشر", "تسعة عشر"];
    const arTens = ["", "عشرة", "عشرون", "ثلاثون", "أربعون", "خمسون", "ستون", "سبعون", "ثمانون", "تسعون"];
    const arHundreds = ["", "مائة", "مائتان", "ثلاثمائة", "أربعمائة", "خمسمائة", "ستمائة", "سبعمائة", "ثمانمائة", "تسعمائة"];

    function convertArabicGroup(num) {
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let t = Math.floor((num % 100) / 10);
        let u = num % 10;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += arHundreds[h];
        }

        let tensUnits = "";
        if (t === 0) {
            if (u > 0) tensUnits = arUnits[u];
        } else if (t === 1) {
            tensUnits = arTeens[u];
        } else {
            if (u > 0) {
                tensUnits = arUnits[u] + " و" + arTens[t];
            } else {
                tensUnits = arTens[t];
            }
        }

        if (tensUnits !== "") {
            if (str !== "") str += " و";
            str += tensUnits;
        }
        return str;
    }

    function tafqeetArabic(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "صفر دينار جزائري";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);

        let dinarStr = "";
        if (dinars === 1) dinarStr = "دينار جزائري واحد";
        else if (dinars === 2) dinarStr = "ديناران جزائريان";
        else if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) {
                if (billions === 1) parts.push("مليار");
                else if (billions === 2) parts.push("ملياران");
                else if (billions >= 3 && billions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليارات");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليار");
            }

            if (millions > 0) {
                if (millions === 1) parts.push("مليون");
                else if (millions === 2) parts.push("مليونان");
                else if (millions >= 3 && millions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " ملايين");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " مليون");
            }

            if (thousands > 0) {
                if (thousands === 1) parts.push("ألف");
                else if (thousands === 2) parts.push("ألفان");
                else if (thousands >= 3 && thousands <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " آلاف");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " ألف");
            }

            if (remainder > 0) {
                parts.push(convertArabicGroup(remainder));
            }

            dinarStr = parts.join(" و") + " دينار جزائري";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            if (centimes === 1) centimeStr = "سنتيم واحد";
            else if (centimes === 2) centimeStr = "سنتيمان";
            else if (centimes >= 3 && centimes <= 10) centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتميات";
            else centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتيماً";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " و " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 2. القاموس الفرنسي (French Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const frUnits = ["", "un", "deux", "trois", "quatre", "cinq", "six", "sept", "huit", "neuf"];
    const frTeens = ["dix", "onze", "douze", "treize", "quatorze", "quinze", "seize", "dix-sept", "dix-huit", "dix-neuf"];
    const frTens = ["", "dix", "vingt", "trente", "quarante", "cinquante", "soixante", "soixante-dix", "quatre-vingts", "quatre-vingt-dix"];

    function convertFrenchGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            if (h === 1) str += "cent ";
            else str += frUnits[h] + " cent " + (rem === 0 ? "s " : "");
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (rem < 10) str += frUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += frTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                if (t === 7) {
                    str += (u === 1 ? "soixante et onze" : "soixante-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : ""));
                } else if (t === 9) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : "");
                } else if (t === 8) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt" + (u === 0 ? "s" : "-" + frUnits[u]);
                } else {
                    str += frTens[t];
                    if (u === 1) str += " et un";
                    else if (u > 1) str += "-" + frUnits[u];
                }
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetFrench(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zéro Dinar Algérien";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(billions) + (billions > 1 ? " milliards" : " milliard"));
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(millions) + (millions > 1 ? " millions" : " million"));
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push((thousands === 1 ? "mille" : convertFrenchGroup(thousands) + " mille"));
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Dinars Algériens";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertFrenchGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        let result = "";
        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) result = dinarStr + " et " + centimeStr;
        else if (centimeStr) result = centimeStr;
        else result = dinarStr;

        // رسملة الحرف الأول
        return result.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + result.slice(1);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 3. القاموس الإنجليزي (English Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const enUnits = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"];
    const enTeens = ["Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"];
    const enTens = ["", "Ten", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];

    function convertEnglishGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += enUnits[h] + " Hundred ";
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (h > 0) str += "and ";
            if (rem < 10) str += enUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += enTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                str += enTens[t];
                if (u > 0) str += "-" + enUnits[u];
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetEnglish(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zero Algerian Dinars";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(billions) + " Billion");
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(millions) + " Million");
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(thousands) + " Thousand");
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Algerian Dinars";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertEnglishGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " and " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // التصدير للاستخدام العام (Public API)
    // ============================================================================
    return {
        /**
         * تحويل رقم مالي إلى حروف حسب اللغة المطلوبة
         * @param {number} num - المبلغ المالي
         * @param {string} lang - رمز اللغة ('ar', 'fr', 'en')
         * @returns {string} المبلغ مفقطاً بالحروف
         */
        toWords: function (num, lang = 'ar') {
            const cleanNum = Number(num);
            if (isNaN(cleanNum)) return "";

            const l = String(lang).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (l === 'fr') return tafqeetFrench(cleanNum);
            if (l === 'en') return tafqeetEnglish(cleanNum);
            
            // الافتراضي هو العربية
            return "فقط " + tafqeetArabic(cleanNum) + " لا غير.";
        }
    };
})();

// توافقية التصدير ليعمل في Node.js (للخلفية) والمتصفح (للواجهة الأمامية)
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = NumberToWords;
} else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.NumberToWords = NumberToWords;
}

 */

// وظيفة جلب النص بناءً على اللغة المفعلة حالياً
function getTranslation(lang, key) {
    const defaultLang = 'ar';
    const langDict = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang];
    return langDict[key] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang][key] || key;
}

// التصدير للاستخدام في الخلفية أو الواجهة الأمامية
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = { TRANSLATIONS, getTranslation };
} else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.TRANSLATIONS = TRANSLATIONS;
    window.getTranslation = getTranslation;
}

/**
 * manufacturing/manufacturing-ui.js
 * محرك عرض وتفاعل واجهة التصنيع والإنتاج (BOM Recipes & Production Orders UI)
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  let tempRecipeComponents = [];

  async function renderManufacturingView() {
    const container = document.getElementById('manufacturing-view-root');
    if (!container || !window.ManufacturingManager) return;

    await window.ManufacturingManager.fetchAllData();
    const { recipes, orders, productsList } = window.ManufacturingManager;

    const confirmedCount = orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'confirmed').length;
    const autoRecipesCount = recipes.filter((r) => Number(r.auto_on_sale) === 1).length;

    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <!-- الشريط العلوي والإحصائيات -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-black">التصنيع والإنتاج (BOM)</h2>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">إدارة وصفات التصنيع، خصم المواد الأولية بـ FIFO، وأوامر الإنتاج الآلية</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.openRecipeModal()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add_circle</span>
              <span>وصفة تصنيع جديدة</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.openQuickProduceModal()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">precision_manufacturing</span>
              <span>أمر إنتاج فوري</span>
            </button>
          </div>

            <div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold">إجمالي وصفات التصنيع</div>
              <div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1">${recipes.length}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-lg text-blue-500">menu_book</span>

                            (o) => `
                        <tr>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${o.number || '#' + o.id}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-bold">${o.product_name || ''}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono">${o.produced_qty || o.planned_qty}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono">${Number(o.unit_cost || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            ${
                              o.status === 'confirmed'
                                ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 font-bold">مؤكد</span>'
                                : o.status === 'reversed'
                                  ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500 font-bold">ملغى</span>'
                                  : '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 font-bold">مسودة</span>'
                            }
                          </td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            ${
                              o.status === 'confirmed'
                                ? `<button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.reverseOrder(${o.id})" class="text-rose-500 hover:underline font-bold">عكس</button>`
                                : o.status === 'draft'
                                  ? `<button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.confirmDraft(${o.id})" class="text-emerald-600 hover:underline font-bold">تأكيد</button>`
                                  : '-'
                            }
                          </td>
                        </tr>`
                          )
                          .join('')
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  async function produceFromRecipe(recipeId) {
    const qtyStr = prompt('أدخل الكمية المراد إنتاجها الآن:', '1');
    const qty = parseFloat(qtyStr);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) return;

    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.createAndConfirmOrder({
        recipe_id: Number(recipeId),
        planned_qty: qty,
        produced_qty: qty,
        confirmImmediately: true
      });
      await renderManufacturingView();
      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم تنفيذ أمر الإنتاج وإضافة الدفعة للمخزون بنجاح', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'تعذر تنفيذ أمر الإنتاج');
    }
  }

  async function deleteRecipe(recipeId) {
    if (!confirm('هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذه الوصفة؟')) return;
    await window.ManufacturingManager.removeRecipe(recipeId);
    await renderManufacturingView();
  }

  async function reverseOrder(orderId) {
    if (!confirm('هل تريد عكس أمر الإنتاج وإرجاع المواد الأولية للمخزون؟')) return;
    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.reverseOrder(orderId);
      await renderManufacturingView();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  }

  async function confirmDraft(orderId) {
    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.confirmDraftOrder(orderId);
      await renderManufacturingView();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  }

  function openRecipeModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('bom-recipe-modal');
    if (modal) {
      tempRecipeComponents = [];
      modal.classList.add('active');
    }
  }

  function openQuickProduceModal() {
    const recipes = (window.ManufacturingManager && window.ManufacturingManager.recipes) || [];
    if (recipes.length === 0) {
      alert('يرجى إنشاء وصفة تصنيع أولاً');
      return;
    }
    produceFromRecipe(recipes[0].id);
  }

  window.ManufacturingUI = {
    renderManufacturingView,
    produceFromRecipe,
    deleteRecipe,
    reverseOrder,
    confirmDraft,
    openRecipeModal,
    openQuickProduceModal
  };
})();

/**
 * manufacturing/manufacturing.js
 * وحدة إدارة حالة التصنيع (BOM State & API Controller) في الواجهة الأمامية
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  const ManufacturingState = {
    recipes: [],
    orders: [],
    productsList: [],
    currentRecipe: null,
    currentAvailability: null,

    async fetchAllData(filters = {}) {
      if (!window.api) return;
      const [recipes, orders, products] = await Promise.all([
        window.api.getBomRecipes(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProductionOrders(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProducts({}).catch(() => [])
      ]);

      this.recipes = Array.isArray(recipes) ? recipes : [];
      this.orders = Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : [];
      this.productsList = Array.isArray(products) ? products : [];
      return {
        recipes: this.recipes,
        orders: this.orders,
        products: this.productsList
      };
    },

    async checkAvailability(recipeId, plannedQty = 1) {
      if (!window.api || !recipeId) return null;
      this.currentAvailability = await window.api.getRecipeAvailability({
        recipeId: Number(recipeId),
        plannedQty: Number(plannedQty || 1)
      });
      return this.currentAvailability;
    },

    async saveRecipe(recipePayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const saved = await window.api.saveBomRecipe(recipePayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return saved;
    },

    async removeRecipe(recipeId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      await window.api.deleteBomRecipe(Number(recipeId));
      await this.fetchAllData();
    },

    async createAndConfirmOrder(orderPayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.createProductionOrder(orderPayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async confirmDraftOrder(orderId, producedQty) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.confirmProductionOrder({
        orderId: Number(orderId),
        produced_qty: producedQty ? Number(producedQty) : undefined
      });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async reverseOrder(orderId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.reverseProductionOrder({ orderId: Number(orderId) });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    }
  };

  window.ManufacturingManager = ManufacturingState;
})();

/**
 * manufacturing/pos-produce.js
 * محرك التصنيع الآلي الفوري عند البيع في شاشة الكاشير (يعمل في Node.js وفي المتصفح معاً)
 */

'use strict';

(function (root) {
  var isNode = typeof require === 'function' && typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  var productionGuard = isNode ? require('./production-guard') : null;

  async function autoProduceShortfallsForSale(db, saleItems, options) {
    if (!isNode || !productionGuard || !db) return [];
    saleItems = Array.isArray(saleItems) ? saleItems : [];
    options = options || {};

    var globalAutoSetting = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_auto_on_sale', 'false');
    var isGlobalAutoEnabled =
      String(globalAutoSetting).toLowerCase() === 'true' || globalAutoSetting === '1';

    var producedOrders = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < saleItems.length; i++) {
      var item = saleItems[i];
      var productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
      var requestedQty = Number(item.quantity || 0);
      if (!productId || requestedQty <= 0) continue;

      var stockRow = await db.dbGet(
        'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS current_stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
        [productId]
      );
      var currentStock = Number((stockRow && stockRow.current_stock) || 0);
      var shortfall = Number((requestedQty - currentStock).toFixed(6));

      if (shortfall <= 0.0001) continue;

      var recipe = await db.dbGet(
        'SELECT * FROM bom_recipes WHERE product_id = ? AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1',
        [productId]
      );

      if (!recipe) continue;
      if (!isGlobalAutoEnabled && !Number(recipe.auto_on_sale)) continue;

      var qtyToProduce = shortfall;
      if (recipe.auto_round === 'batch' && Number(recipe.output_qty) > 0) {
        var batchesNeeded = Math.ceil(shortfall / Number(recipe.output_qty));
        qtyToProduce = batchesNeeded * Number(recipe.output_qty);
      }

      try {
        var avail = await productionGuard.computeRecipeAvailability(db, {
          recipeId: recipe.id,
          plannedQty: qtyToProduce
        });

        if (avail && avail.can_produce) {
          var order = await productionGuard.createProductionOrder(db, {
            recipe_id: recipe.id,
            planned_qty: qtyToProduce,
            produced_qty: qtyToProduce,
            trigger_source: 'auto_pos_sale',
            sale_id: options.saleId || null,
            user_id: options.userId || null,
            confirmImmediately: true,
            note: 'إنتاج تلقائي لتغطية بيع الكاشير'
          });
          producedOrders.push(order);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[Auto-Produce POS] Skipped product #' + productId + ':', err.message);
      }
    }

    return producedOrders;
  }

  if (isNode) {
    module.exports = { autoProduceShortfallsForSale: autoProduceShortfallsForSale };
  } else if (root) {
    root.PosProduce = {
      openQuickProduceModal: function () {
        if (root.App && typeof root.App.openPosQuickProduceModal === 'function') {
          root.App.openPosQuickProduceModal();
        }
      }
    };
  }
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
