==================== FILE: perf-core/perf-core.js (16.5 KB) ====================
/**
 * perf-core/perf-core.js
 * الشطر 2 (v2.1): المحرك العام للأداء وحوكمة المؤقتات و Proxy آمن لـ contextBridge
 */
'use strict';
(function buildSafePerfCoreModule() {
  (function initGherbiPerfCore() {
    'use strict';

    if (window.GherbiPerfCore && window.GherbiPerfCore._installed) {
      return;
    }

    const nativeSetInterval = window.setInterval.bind(window);
    const nativeClearInterval = window.clearInterval.bind(window);
    const nativeRaf =
      typeof window.requestAnimationFrame === 'function'
        ? window.requestAnimationFrame.bind(window)
        : (cb) => setTimeout(cb, 16);

    const READ_TTL_MAP = {
      getProducts: 1800,
      getPosStock: 1800,
      getCategories: 4000,
      getFamilies: 4000,
      getProductSuppliers: 4000,
      getSuppliers: 2500,
      getSettings: 3000,
      getUsers: 4000,
      getBundles: 2500,
      getPromotions: 2500,
      getProformas: 1500,
      getOrders: 1500,
      getPurchases: 1500,
      getExpenses: 1500,
      getCapital: 2000,
      getCaisseSessions: 1200,
      getSales: 700,
      getCustomers: 600,
      getCustomersDebt: 600,
      getActiveSession: 600
    };

    const WRITE_PREFIX_RE =
      /^(add|update|delete|save|create|process|openCaisse|closeCaisse|confirm|reverse|cancel|issue|mark|convert|toggle|merge|set|setup|restore|import|reset)/;

    const PerfCore = {
      _installed: true,
      version: '2.1.0-war-stage2-contextbridge-safe',
      activeView: 'pos',
      ipcCacheMode: 'pending',
      api: null,

      _intervals: new Map(),
      _viewIntervals: new Map(),
      _enterListeners: new Map(),
      _leaveListeners: new Map(),
      _rafPending: new Map(),

      _ipcCache: new Map(),
      _ipcInflight: new Map(),
      _ipcWrapped: false,

      metrics: {
        skippedHiddenTicks: 0,
        skippedInactiveViewTicks: 0,
        skippedOverlapTicks: 0,
        quiescedLegacyIntervals: 0,
        ipcCacheHits: 0,
        ipcInflightCoalesced: 0,
        ipcCacheInvalidations: 0,
        lastViewSwitchMs: 0,
        viewSwitchCount: 0
      },

      getActiveView() {
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.querySelector) {
          const activeSec = document.querySelector('.view-section.active');
          if (activeSec && activeSec.id && activeSec.id.startsWith('view-')) {
            this.activeView = activeSec.id.slice(5);
          }
        }
        return this.activeView || 'pos';
      },

      debounce(fn, waitMs = 150) {
        let timer = null;
        return function debounced(...args) {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = setTimeout(() => {
            timer = null;
            fn.apply(this, args);
          }, waitMs);
        };
      },

      rafBatch(key, fn) {
        const k = String(key || 'default');
        if (this._rafPending.has(k)) return;
        this._rafPending.set(k, true);
        nativeRaf(() => {
          this._rafPending.delete(k);
          try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PerfCore rAF Warning]:', e.message); }
        });
      },

      onViewEnter(viewName, fn) {
        const v = String(viewName || '*');
        if (!this._enterListeners.has(v)) this._enterListeners.set(v, new Set());
        this._enterListeners.get(v).add(fn);
        return () => this._enterListeners.get(v)?.delete(fn);
      },

      onViewLeave(viewName, fn) {
        const v = String(viewName || '*');
        if (!this._leaveListeners.has(v)) this._leaveListeners.set(v, new Set());
        this._leaveListeners.get(v).add(fn);
        return () => this._leaveListeners.get(v)?.delete(fn);
      },

      registerViewInterval(viewName, fn, delayMs = 1000) {
        const targetView = String(viewName || 'pos');
        let running = false;
        const wrapped = () => {
          if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden) {
            this.metrics.skippedHiddenTicks++;
            return;
          }
          if (this.getActiveView() !== targetView) {
            this.metrics.skippedInactiveViewTicks++;
            return;
          }
          if (running) {
            this.metrics.skippedOverlapTicks++;
            return;
          }
          running = true;
          try {
            const out = fn();
            if (out && typeof out.finally === 'function') {
              out.finally(() => { running = false; });
            } else {
              running = false;
            }
          } catch (_) {
            running = false;
          }
        };
        const id = nativeSetInterval(wrapped, Math.max(50, Number(delayMs || 1000)));
        this._viewIntervals.set(id, { viewName: targetView, delayMs });
        return id;
      },

      unregisterViewInterval(id) {
        this._viewIntervals.delete(id);
        nativeClearInterval(id);
      },

      invalidateCache(reason = '') {
        this._ipcCache.clear();
        this.metrics.ipcCacheInvalidations++;
        if (reason) this._lastInvalidationReason = reason;
      },

      // بناء Proxy آمن للكاش وتوحيد الطلبات دون تعديل أي خاصية مجمّدة على window.api
      _createCachedApiProxy(rawApi) {
        const self = this;
        const wrappedFns = new Map();

        return new Proxy({}, {
          get(target, prop) {
            const val = rawApi[prop];
            if (typeof prop !== 'string' || typeof val !== 'function') {
              return val;
            }
            if (wrappedFns.has(prop)) {
              return wrappedFns.get(prop);
            }

            const origFn = val.bind(rawApi);

            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(READ_TTL_MAP, prop)) {
              const ttlMs = READ_TTL_MAP[prop];
              const readWrapper = function cachedReadProxy(...args) {
                let argKey = '';
                try {
                  argKey = args.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(args) : '';
                } catch (_) {
                  return origFn(...args);
                }
                const cacheKey = `${prop}:${argKey}`;
                const now = Date.now();

                const cached = self._ipcCache.get(cacheKey);
                if (cached && now - cached.ts <= ttlMs) {
                  self.metrics.ipcCacheHits++;
                  const cv = cached.value;
                  return Promise.resolve(Array.isArray(cv) ? cv.slice() : cv);
                }

                if (self._ipcInflight.has(cacheKey)) {
                  self.metrics.ipcInflightCoalesced++;
                  return self._ipcInflight.get(cacheKey).then((cv) =>
                    Array.isArray(cv) ? cv.slice() : cv
                  );
                }

                const p = Promise.resolve()
                  .then(() => origFn(...args))
                  .then((res) => {
                    self._ipcInflight.delete(cacheKey);
                    self._ipcCache.set(cacheKey, { ts: Date.now(), value: res });
                    return Array.isArray(res) ? res.slice() : res;
                  })
                  .catch((err) => {
                    self._ipcInflight.delete(cacheKey);
                    throw err;
                  });

                self._ipcInflight.set(cacheKey, p);
                return p;
              };
              wrappedFns.set(prop, readWrapper);
              return readWrapper;
            }

            if (WRITE_PREFIX_RE.test(prop)) {
              const writeWrapper = function invalidatingWriteProxy(...args) {
                self.invalidateCache(prop);
                const out = origFn(...args);
                if (out && typeof out.then === 'function') {
                  return out.then((res) => {
                    self.invalidateCache(prop);
                    return res;
                  });
                }
                return out;
              };
              wrappedFns.set(prop, writeWrapper);
              return writeWrapper;
            }

            wrappedFns.set(prop, origFn);
            return origFn;
          }
        });
      },

      installIpcSmartCache() {
        if (this._ipcWrapped) return true;
        const rawApi = window.api;
        if (!rawApi || typeof rawApi !== 'object') return false;
        this._ipcWrapped = true;

        const cachedProxy = this._createCachedApiProxy(rawApi);
        this.api = cachedProxy;

        // محاولة الربط الشفاف على window.api فقط إذا سمح واصف الخاصية بذلك (بدون رمي أي TypeError أبداً)
        try {
          const winDesc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, 'api');
          if (!winDesc || winDesc.writable) {
            window.api = cachedProxy;
            this.ipcCacheMode = 'window.api-proxy';
            return true;
          }
          if (winDesc.configurable) {
            Object.defineProperty(window, 'api', {
              value: cachedProxy,
              writable: true,
              configurable: true,
              enumerable: true
            });
            this.ipcCacheMode = 'window.api-redefined';
            return true;
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        // إذا كان الكائن نفسه غير مجمّد، نعدّل الخصائص القابلة للكتابة فقط
        if (!Object.isFrozen(rawApi)) {
          let patchedAny = false;
          for (const key of Object.keys(rawApi)) {
            if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(READ_TTL_MAP, key) && !WRITE_PREFIX_RE.test(key)) {
              continue;
            }
            const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(rawApi, key);
            if (!d || d.writable) {
              try {
                rawApi[key] = cachedProxy[key];
                patchedAny = true;
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          }
          if (patchedAny) {
            this.ipcCacheMode = 'window.api-inplace';
            return true;
          }
        }

        // وضع Electron contextBridge المجمّد: الكائن محمي ولا يمكن تعديله؛ نُبقي PerfCore.api جاهزاً دون أي خطأ
        this.ipcCacheMode = 'PerfCore.api (contextBridge frozen)';
        return true;
      },

      installSmartTimerGovernance() {
        const self = this;

        window.setInterval = function governedSetInterval(fn, delay, ...args) {
          if (typeof fn !== 'function') {
            return nativeSetInterval(fn, delay, ...args);
          }

          const ms = Number(delay || 0);
          let src = '';
          try { src = Function.prototype.toString.call(fn); } catch (_) {}

          const isCleanPro = src.includes('GherbiPrintStudioPro') || src.includes('GherbiPerfCore');
          const isCritical =
            isCleanPro ||
            ms < 250 ||
            /scale|cloud|sync|clock|toLocaleTimeString|heartbeat|revision/i.test(src);

          let scopedView = null;
          if (!isCleanPro) {
            if (/refreshLivePosDebtBannerAndButtons|v68CustomerLiveDebtBanner|posCartItems/.test(src)) {
              scopedView = 'pos';
            } else if (/v45MasterPrintStudio|v61LeftSidebarHost|renderV75MasterStudio|renderV76MasterStudio/.test(src)) {
              scopedView = '__LEGACY_PRINT__';
            }
          }

          let running = false;
          let timerId = null;

          const wrappedFn = function () {
            if (scopedView === '__LEGACY_PRINT__' && window.GherbiPrintStudioPro && window.GherbiPrintStudioPro._bootstrapped) {
              self.metrics.quiescedLegacyIntervals++;
              if (timerId !== null) {
                self._intervals.delete(timerId);
                nativeClearInterval(timerId);
              }
              return;
            }

            if (!isCritical && typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden) {
              self.metrics.skippedHiddenTicks++;
              return;
            }

            if (scopedView && scopedView !== '__LEGACY_PRINT__' && self.getActiveView() !== scopedView) {
              self.metrics.skippedInactiveViewTicks++;
              return;
            }

            if (running) {
              self.metrics.skippedOverlapTicks++;
              return;
            }

            running = true;
            try {
              const res = fn.apply(this, args);
              if (res && typeof res.finally === 'function') {
                res.finally(() => { running = false; });
              } else {
                running = false;
              }
            } catch (e) {
              running = false;
              throw e;
            }
          };

          timerId = nativeSetInterval(wrappedFn, ms);
          self._intervals.set(timerId, {
            delay: ms,
            scopedView,
            isCritical,
            createdAt: Date.now()
          });
          return timerId;
        };

        window.clearInterval = function governedClearInterval(id) {
          self._intervals.delete(id);
          self._viewIntervals.delete(id);
          return nativeClearInterval(id);
        };
      },

      notifyViewTransition(prevView, nextView, durationMs) {
        this.activeView = nextView;
        this.metrics.lastViewSwitchMs = Number(durationMs.toFixed(1));
        this.metrics.viewSwitchCount++;

        if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.body && document.body.dataset) {
          document.body.dataset.activeView = nextView;
        }

        if (prevView && prevView !== nextView) {
          const leaveSet = this._leaveListeners.get(prevView);
          if (leaveSet) leaveSet.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(prevView, nextView); } catch (_) {} });
          const anyLeave = this._leaveListeners.get('*');
          if (anyLeave) anyLeave.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(prevView, nextView); } catch (_) {} });
        }

        const enterSet = this._enterListeners.get(nextView);
        if (enterSet) enterSet.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(nextView, prevView); } catch (_) {} });
        const anyEnter = this._enterListeners.get('*');
        if (anyEnter) anyEnter.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(nextView, prevView); } catch (_) {} });
      },

      hookAppSwitchView() {
        const app = window.App;
        if (!app || typeof app.switchView !== 'function' || app._perfCoreHooked) return false;
        app._perfCoreHooked = true;
        const origSwitch = app.switchView.bind(app);
        const self = this;

        app.switchView = async function perfWrappedSwitchView(viewName, ...rest) {
          const prevView = self.getActiveView();
          const t0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
          const result = await origSwitch(viewName, ...rest);
          const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
          self.notifyViewTransition(prevView, String(viewName || self.getActiveView()), Math.max(0, t1 - t0));
          return result;
        };
        return true;
      },

      getDiagnostics() {
        return {
          version: this.version,
          activeView: this.getActiveView(),
          ipcCacheMode: this.ipcCacheMode,
          trackedGlobalIntervals: this._intervals.size,
          trackedViewIntervals: this._viewIntervals.size,
          ipcCacheEntries: this._ipcCache.size,
          ipcWrapped: this._ipcWrapped,
          metrics: { ...this.metrics }
        };
      },

      boot() {
        try { this.installSmartTimerGovernance(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PerfCore Timer Warning]:', e.message); }
        try { this.installIpcSmartCache(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PerfCore IPC Warning]:', e.message); }
        try { this.hookAppSwitchView(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PerfCore SwitchView Warning]:', e.message); }

        let tries = 0;
        const bootTimer = nativeSetInterval(() => {
          tries++;
          let ipcOk = false;
          let viewOk = false;
          try { ipcOk = this.installIpcSmartCache(); } catch (_) {}
          try { viewOk = this.hookAppSwitchView(); } catch (_) {}
          if ((ipcOk && viewOk) || tries >= 50) {
            nativeClearInterval(bootTimer);
          }
        }, 100);

        console.log('⚡ [Gherbi Perf Core v2.1]: نشط 100% — وضع IPC:', this.ipcCacheMode);
      }
    };

    window.GherbiPerfCore = PerfCore;
    PerfCore.boot();
  })();
})();

/**
 * perf-core/pos-debt-stage3.js
 * الشطر 3: تسريع شاشة المبيعات (#view-pos) وضبط طباعة الكاشير والديون (Échap, F1, Alt+D, Alt+V, Alt+H, F8)

'use strict';
(function buildPosDebtStage3Module() {
  (function initGherbiPosAndDebtStage3() {
    'use strict';

    if (window.GherbiPosStage3 && window.GherbiPosStage3._installed) {
      return;
    }

    const PosStage3 = {
      _installed: true,
      version: '3.0.0-war-stage3',

      // فهرس الباركود السريع O(1)
      _barcodeIndex: new Map(),
      _barcodeSourceRef: null,
      _barcodeSourceLen: -1,

      // مؤقتات دمج التحديثات
      _searchTimer: null,
      _custDisplayTimer: null,
      _lastGridSig: '',

      metrics: {
        barcodeIndexHits: 0,
        barcodeIndexRebuilds: 0,
        searchDebouncedCalls: 0,
        cartFramesCoalesced: 0,
        bannerFramesCoalesced: 0,
        freshCustomerSyncs: 0,
        routedPosPrints: 0
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // أ) فهرسة الباركودات O(1) (أساسي + فرعي + متغيرات + PLU)
      // ======================================================================
      rebuildBarcodeIndex(productsList) {
        const list = Array.isArray(productsList)
          ? productsList
          : (window.AppState && Array.isArray(window.AppState.products) ? window.AppState.products : []);
        this._barcodeIndex.clear();
        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          const p = list[i];
          if (!p) continue;
          if (p.barcode) {
            const k = String(p.barcode).trim();
            if (k) this._barcodeIndex.set(k, { product: p, variant: null, priceLabel: null });
          }
          if (p.plu_code) {
            const plu = String(p.plu_code).trim();
            if (plu && !this._barcodeIndex.has(plu)) {
              this._barcodeIndex.set(plu, { product: p, variant: null, priceLabel: null });
            }
          }
          const extras = Array.isArray(p.extra_barcodes) ? p.extra_barcodes : Array.isArray(p.barcodes) ? p.barcodes : [];
          for (let j = 0; j < extras.length; j++) {
            const eb = extras[j];
            const code = typeof eb === 'string' ? eb.trim() : String(eb && eb.barcode ? eb.barcode : '').trim();
            if (code) {
              this._barcodeIndex.set(code, {
                product: p,
                variant: null,
                priceLabel: typeof eb === 'object' && eb ? (eb.price_label || null) : null
              });
            }
          }
          const variants = Array.isArray(p.variants) ? p.variants : [];
          for (let v = 0; v < variants.length; v++) {
            const vr = variants[v];
            if (vr && vr.barcode) {
              const vc = String(vr.barcode).trim();
              if (vc) this._barcodeIndex.set(vc, { product: p, variant: vr, priceLabel: null });
            }
          }
        }
        this._barcodeSourceRef = list;
        this._barcodeSourceLen = list.length;
        this.metrics.barcodeIndexRebuilds++;
        return this._barcodeIndex.size;
      },

      lookupBarcodeFast(rawCode, productsList) {
        const code = String(rawCode || '').trim();
        if (!code) return null;
        const list = Array.isArray(productsList)
          ? productsList
          : (window.AppState && Array.isArray(window.AppState.products) ? window.AppState.products : []);
        if (list !== this._barcodeSourceRef || list.length !== this._barcodeSourceLen || this._barcodeIndex.size === 0) {
          this.rebuildBarcodeIndex(list);
        }
        const hit = this._barcodeIndex.get(code) || null;
        if (hit) this.metrics.barcodeIndexHits++;
        return hit;
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // ب) مزامنة حية لبيانات ورصيد الزبون من SQLite قبل أي طباعة
      // ======================================================================
      async fetchFreshCustomerForPrint(customerId) {
        const cid = Number(customerId || 0);
        if (cid <= 0) return null;

        this.metrics.freshCustomerSyncs++;
        if (window.GherbiPerfCore && typeof window.GherbiPerfCore.invalidateCache === 'function') {
          window.GherbiPerfCore.invalidateCache('pre_print_customer_sync');
        }

        let custObj = null;
        let creditSummary = null;

        try {
          const tasks = [];
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getCustomerCreditSummary === 'function') {
            tasks.push(window.api.getCustomerCreditSummary(cid).then((r) => { creditSummary = r; }).catch(() => {}));
          }
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getCustomers === 'function') {
            tasks.push(window.api.getCustomers({}).then((rows) => {
              if (Array.isArray(rows)) {
                custObj = rows.find((c) => Number(c.id) === cid) || null;
                if (window.AppState) window.AppState.customers = rows;
                if (window.GherbiDebtV68 && window.GherbiDebtV68.customersById) {
                  window.GherbiDebtV68.customers = rows;
                  window.GherbiDebtV68.customersById.clear();
                  rows.forEach((c) => window.GherbiDebtV68.customersById.set(Number(c.id), c));
                }
              }
            }).catch(() => {}));
          }
          await Promise.all(tasks);
        } catch (_) {}

        if (!custObj && !creditSummary) return null;

        const currentDebt = Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            creditSummary && creditSummary.current_debt !== undefined
              ? creditSummary.current_debt
              : (custObj && custObj.total_debt) || 0
          )
        );

        const fid = (custObj && custObj.loyalty_card_code) || ('FID-' + String(cid).padStart(5, '0'));
        return {
          id: cid,
          name: (custObj && custObj.name) || (creditSummary && creditSummary.name) || `زبون #${cid}`,
          fid,
          phone: (custObj && custObj.phone) || '',
          address: (custObj && custObj.address) || '',
          rc: (custObj && custObj.rc) || '',
          nif: (custObj && custObj.nif) || '',
          loyaltyPoints: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number((custObj && custObj.loyalty_points) || 0))),
          currentDebt: Number(currentDebt.toFixed(2)),
          totalSales: Number((custObj && custObj.total_sales) || 0),
          totalPaid: Number((custObj && custObj.total_paid) || 0)
        };
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // ج) موجهات الطباعة الدقيقة لشاشة المبيعات ومنظومة الديون
      // ======================================================================

      // 1. طباعة تذكرة الكاشير أو الفاتورة (Échap / F1) مع حارس الزبون العابر
      async printPosSaleTicket(saleOrId, format = '80mm', opts = {}) {
        const PSP = window.GherbiPrintStudioPro;
        if (!PSP || !PSP.router) return { ok: false, error: 'psp_not_ready' };

        const docType = format === 'a4' ? 'invoice_a4' : format === 'a5' ? 'invoice_a5' : 'receipt_thermal';
        let data = typeof saleOrId === 'object' && saleOrId
          ? { ...saleOrId }
          : await PSP.router.fetchDocDataByEntityId(docType, saleOrId);

        const cid = Number(data.customerId || data.customer_id || 0);
        if (cid > 0) {
          const fresh = await this.fetchFreshCustomerForPrint(cid);
          if (fresh) {
            data.customerId = fresh.id;
            data.isWalkinCustomer = false;
            data.partyName = `${fresh.name} (${fresh.fid})`;
            data.partyPhone = fresh.phone || data.partyPhone || '';
            data.partyAddress = fresh.address || data.partyAddress || '';
            data.loyaltyTotalBalance = fresh.loyaltyPoints;
            data.customerCurrentTotalDebt = fresh.currentDebt;
          }
        } else {
          data.customerId = null;
          data.isWalkinCustomer = true;
          data.partyName = 'زبون عابر (Comptoir)';
          data.loyaltyTotalBalance = 0;
          data.loyaltyPointsEarned = 0;
          data.previousBalance = 0;
          data.customerCurrentTotalDebt = 0;
        }

        this.metrics.routedPosPrints++;
        if (opts.renderOnly) {
          return PSP.router.renderDoc(docType, data, opts.asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'print', { paperSize: format });
        }

      },

      // 2. طباعة تذكرة الدين الجديد / الدفع الجزئي (Alt+D) بالتبديل الذكي بين #10 و #11
      async printAltDCreditTicket(rawSaleData, opts = {}) {
        const PSP = window.GherbiPrintStudioPro;
        if (!PSP || !PSP.router) return { ok: false, error: 'psp_not_ready' };

        const data = { ...(rawSaleData || {}) };
        const total = Math.max(0, Number(data.total ?? 0));
        const paid = Math.max(0, Number(data.paidAmount ?? data.paid_amount ?? 0));
        const addedToday = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
        const cid = Number(data.customerId || data.customer_id || 0);

        const fresh = cid > 0 ? await this.fetchFreshCustomerForPrint(cid) : null;
        const explicitPrev =
          data.previousBalance !== undefined && data.previousBalance !== null && data.previousBalance !== ''
            ? Math.max(0, Number(data.previousBalance))
            : null;

        let prevDebt = 0;
        let newTotalDebt = addedToday;

        if (fresh) {
          data.customerId = fresh.id;
          data.isWalkinCustomer = false;
          data.partyTitle = data.partyTitle || 'الزبون الوفي:';
          data.partyName = `${fresh.name} (${fresh.fid})`;
          data.partyPhone = fresh.phone || data.partyPhone || '';
          data.partyAddress = fresh.address || data.partyAddress || '';
          data.loyaltyTotalBalance = fresh.loyaltyPoints;

          if (explicitPrev !== null) {
            prevDebt = explicitPrev;
          } else {
            // إذا كان SQLite قد حفظ فاتورة اليوم بالفعل فالدين السابق = fresh.currentDebt - addedToday
            prevDebt = fresh.currentDebt >= addedToday
              ? Math.max(0, Number((fresh.currentDebt - addedToday).toFixed(2)))
              : fresh.currentDebt;
          }
          newTotalDebt = Math.max(Number((prevDebt + addedToday).toFixed(2)), fresh.currentDebt);
        } else {
          prevDebt = explicitPrev !== null ? explicitPrev : 0;
          newTotalDebt = Number((prevDebt + addedToday).toFixed(2));
        }

        data.total = total;
        data.paidAmount = paid;
        data.remainingDebt = addedToday;
        data.previousBalance = prevDebt;
        data.customerCurrentTotalDebt = newTotalDebt;

        // التوجيه الذكي: دين كلي (#10) مقابل دفع جزئي (#11)
        const docType = paid <= 0.009 ? 'debt_confirm_ticket_80mm' : 'pos_partial_credit_80mm';
        this.metrics.routedPosPrints++;

        if (opts.renderOnly) {
          return PSP.router.renderDoc(docType, data, opts.asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'print', { paperSize: '80mm' });
        }
        return await PSP.router.printDocumentByType(docType, data, { ...opts, paperSize: '80mm' });
      },

      async printAltVSettlementReceipt(rawPayData, opts = {}) {

        data.remainingDebt = data.customerCurrentTotalDebt;

      },

      // 5. طباعة السجل العام لجميع الزبائن المدينين بالمتجر (#16 — A4)
      async printGlobalDebtorsRegisterA4(opts = {}) {

          items,
          subtotal: totalStoreDebt,
          discount: 0,
          total: totalStoreDebt,
          paidAmount: 0,
          receivedAmount: 0,
          remainingDebt: totalStoreDebt,
          customerCurrentTotalDebt: totalStoreDebt
        };

        this.metrics.routedPosPrints++;
        if (opts.renderOnly) {
          return PSP.router.renderDoc('global_debtors_register_a4', docData, opts.asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'print', { paperSize: 'a4' });
        }
        if (opts.preview) {
          PSP.router.openQuickPreviewModal('global_debtors_register_a4', docData, { paperSize: 'a4' });
          return { ok: true, preview: true };
        }
        return await PSP.router.printDocumentByType('global_debtors_register_a4', docData, { ...opts, paperSize: 'a4' });
      },

      // 6. طباعة بطاقة الزبون الوفي الشاملة (F8 — #17 80mm)
      async printF8VipCard(customerId, opts = {}) {
        const PSP = window.GherbiPrintStudioPro;
        if (!PSP || !PSP.router) return { ok: false, error: 'psp_not_ready' };

        await this.fetchFreshCustomerForPrint(customerId);
        const stmtData = await PSP.router.buildCustomerDebtStatementData(customerId);
        if (!stmtData) return { ok: false, error: 'customer_not_found' };

        this.metrics.routedPosPrints++;
        if (opts.renderOnly) {
          return PSP.router.renderDoc('f8_vip_loyalty_debt_card_80mm', stmtData, opts.asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'print', { paperSize: '80mm' });
        }
        if (opts.preview) {
          PSP.router.openQuickPreviewModal('f8_vip_loyalty_debt_card_80mm', stmtData, { paperSize: '80mm' });
          return { ok: true, preview: true };
        }
        return await PSP.router.printDocumentByType('f8_vip_loyalty_debt_card_80mm', stmtData, { ...opts, paperSize: '80mm' });
      },

      // ======================================================================
      // د) ربط التحسينات بالواجهة الحية لشاشة المبيعات (#view-pos) ومنظومة الديون
      // ======================================================================
      installPosPerformanceHooks() {
        const app = window.App;
        const perf = window.GherbiPerfCore;

        // 1. Debounce ذكي لمربع البحث #globalPosSearch (فوري عند التفريغ، 110ms أثناء الكتابة السريعة)
        if (app && typeof app.onPosSearchInput === 'function' && !app._stage3SearchDebounced) {
          app._stage3SearchDebounced = true;
          const origSearch = app.onPosSearchInput.bind(app);
          const self = this;

          app.onPosSearchInput = function debouncedPosSearch(val) {
            const str = String(val ?? '');
            clearTimeout(self._searchTimer);
            if (!str.trim()) {
              return origSearch(str);
            }
            self.metrics.searchDebouncedCalls++;
            self._searchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              origSearch(str);
            }, 110);
          };
        }

        // 2. دمج تحديثات السلة في إطار رسومي واحد (rAF) لتفادي إعادة الرسم المتكرر أثناء المسح السريع
        if (app && typeof app.renderCart === 'function' && !app._stage3CartCoalesced) {
          app._stage3CartCoalesced = true;
          const origRenderCart = app.renderCart.bind(app);
          const self = this;

          app.renderCart = function coalescedRenderCart(...args) {
            if (!perf || typeof perf.rafBatch !== 'function') {
              return origRenderCart(...args);
            }
            self.metrics.cartFramesCoalesced++;
            perf.rafBatch('pos_cart_render', () => {
              origRenderCart(...args);
            });
          };
        }

        // 3. تقليل استدعاءات شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية أثناء المسح المتتالي
        if (app && typeof app.pushCustomerDisplayState === 'function' && !app._stage3CustDisplayThrottled) {
          app._stage3CustDisplayThrottled = true;
          const origPush = app.pushCustomerDisplayState.bind(app);
          const self = this;
          app.pushCustomerDisplayState = function throttledCustomerDisplay(...args) {
            clearTimeout(self._custDisplayTimer);
            self._custDisplayTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              origPush(...args);
            }, 60);
          };
        }

        // 4. دمج تحديث شريط الديون الحي في السلة وتقييده بصفحة #view-pos فقط
        const debtEng = window.GherbiDebtV68;
        if (debtEng && !debtEng._stage3Hooked) {
          debtEng._stage3Hooked = true;
          const self = this;

          if (typeof debtEng.refreshLivePosDebtBannerAndButtons === 'function') {
            const origBanner = debtEng.refreshLivePosDebtBannerAndButtons.bind(debtEng);
            debtEng.refreshLivePosDebtBannerAndButtons = function scopedPosDebtBanner() {
              if (perf && perf.getActiveView() !== 'pos') return;
              self.metrics.bannerFramesCoalesced++;
              if (perf && typeof perf.rafBatch === 'function') {
                perf.rafBatch('pos_debt_banner', () => origBanner());
              } else {
                origBanner();
              }
            };
          }

          // ربط طباعة كرني/كشف الديون والسجل العام للمدينين وبطاقة F8
          debtEng.printCustomerStatementNow = (cid, fmt = '80mm', direct = false) =>
            self.printAltHDebtHistory(cid, fmt === 'a4' ? 'ledger_a4' : 'carnet_80mm', { preview: !direct });
          debtEng.printGlobalDebtorsRegister = (direct = false) =>
            self.printGlobalDebtorsRegisterA4({ preview: !direct });
          debtEng.printF8VipCard = (cid, direct = false) =>
            self.printF8VipCard(cid, { preview: !direct });
        }

        // 5. حارس تصفير الزبون العابر على #posCustomerSelect
        const custSel = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById('posCustomerSelect') : null;
        if (custSel && !custSel._stage3WalkinGuardBound) {
          custSel._stage3WalkinGuardBound = true;
          custSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
            if (!custSel.value || Number(custSel.value) <= 0) {
              window.__gherbiActivePosCustomerId = 0;
            } else {
              window.__gherbiActivePosCustomerId = Number(custSel.value);
            }
          });
        }

        // 5ب. ربط App.handleBarcodeScan بفهرس الباركود السريع O(1) لرفع سرعة المسح في الكاشير
        if (app && typeof app.handleBarcodeScan === 'function' && !app._stage3BarcodeHooked) {
          app._stage3BarcodeHooked = true;
          const origScan = app.handleBarcodeScan.bind(app);
          const selfScan = this;
          app.handleBarcodeScan = function fastIndexedBarcodeScan(rawCode, ...rest) {
            const code = String(rawCode || '').trim();
            if (code) {
              const fastHit = selfScan.lookupBarcodeFast(code);
              if (fastHit && fastHit.product && !fastHit.variant && !fastHit.priceLabel && typeof app.addToCart === 'function' && !fastHit.product.has_variants) {
                // إذا لم يكن باركود ميزان يبدأ بـ 20، نضيفه لحظياً ونفرغ حقل الباركود
                if (!code.startsWith('20') || code.length !== 13) {
                  try {
                    const bcInp = document.getElementById('barcodeInput');
                    if (bcInp) bcInp.value = '';
                    return app.addToCart(fastHit.product.id);
                  } catch (_) {}
                }
              }
            }
            return origScan(rawCode, ...rest);
          };
        }

        // 6. إعادة بناء فهرس الباركود تلقائياً عند العودة إلى شاشة المبيعات
        if (perf && typeof perf.onViewEnter === 'function' && !this._viewEnterBound) {
          this._viewEnterBound = true;
          perf.onViewEnter('pos', () => {
            this.rebuildBarcodeIndex();
          });
        }
      },

      getDiagnostics() {
        return {
          version: this.version,
          indexedBarcodesCount: this._barcodeIndex.size,
          metrics: { ...this.metrics }
        };
      },

      boot() {
        this.installPosPerformanceHooks();
        this.rebuildBarcodeIndex();

        let tries = 0;
        const t = setInterval(() => {
          tries++;
          this.installPosPerformanceHooks();
          if (
            tries >= 40 ||
            (window.App && window.App._stage3SearchDebounced && (!window.GherbiDebtV68 || window.GherbiDebtV68._stage3Hooked))
          ) {
            clearInterval(t);
          }
        }, 120);

        console.log('⚡ [Gherbi War Stage 3 — POS & Debt Turbo]: تسريع الكاشير وضبط طباعة الديون (Alt+D/V/H/F8) نشط 100%.');
      }
    };

    window.GherbiPosStage3 = PosStage3;
    PosStage3.boot();
  })();
})();

/**
 * perf-core/treasury-funding-stage6a.js

'use strict';
(function buildStage6ATreasuryModule() {
  (function initWarStage6ATreasuryAndSuppliers() {
    'use strict';

    if (window.GherbiTreasuryStage6A && window.GherbiTreasuryStage6A._installed) {
      return;
    }

    function fmtDzd(v) {
      const n = Number(v || 0);
      return n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + ' د.ج';
    }

    function showInlineAlert(msg, level) {
      const box = document.getElementById('supPayInlineAlert');
      if (!box) return;
      if (!msg) {
        box.classList.add('hidden');
        box.textContent = '';
        return;
      }
      box.classList.remove('hidden', 'bg-rose-500/10', 'border-rose-500/40', 'text-rose-600', 'bg-amber-500/10', 'border-amber-500/40', 'text-amber-700', 'bg-emerald-500/10', 'border-emerald-500/40', 'text-emerald-700');
      if (level === 'warning') {
        box.classList.add('bg-amber-500/10', 'border-amber-500/40', 'text-amber-700');
      } else if (level === 'success') {
        box.classList.add('bg-emerald-500/10', 'border-emerald-500/40', 'text-emerald-700');
      } else {
        box.classList.add('bg-rose-500/10', 'border-rose-500/40', 'text-rose-600');
      }
      box.textContent = msg;
    }

    const Stage6A = {
      _installed: true,
      version: '6A.0.0-treasury-suppliers',
      _activeSupplier: null,
      _treasuryStatus: null,

      async loadTreasuryStatus() {
        const uid = window.AppState?.currentUser?.id || null;
        try {
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getTreasuryStatus === 'function') {
            this._treasuryStatus = await window.api.getTreasuryStatus(uid);
            return this._treasuryStatus;
          }
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getActiveSession === 'function') {
            const sess = await window.api.getActiveSession(uid);
            this._treasuryStatus = {
              hasOpenShift: Boolean(sess && sess.session && sess.session.id),
              sessionId: sess && sess.session ? sess.session.id : null,
              cashierName: sess && sess.session ? (sess.session.user_name || '') : '',
              drawerExpectedCash: sess && sess.summary ? Number(sess.summary.expectedBalance || 0) : 0,
              vaultBalance: 0
            };
            return this._treasuryStatus;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        this._treasuryStatus = { hasOpenShift: false, sessionId: null, drawerExpectedCash: 0, vaultBalance: 0 };
        return this._treasuryStatus;
      },

      async resolveSupplierById(supplierId) {
        const sid = Number(supplierId || 0);
        if (!sid) return null;
        try {
          if (window.api && typeof window.api.getSuppliers === 'function') {
            const list = await window.api.getSuppliers();
            if (Array.isArray(list)) {
              if (window.AppState) window.AppState.suppliers = list;
              const found = list.find((s) => Number(s.id) === sid);
              if (found) return found;
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        const cached = (window.AppState && Array.isArray(window.AppState.suppliers)) ? window.AppState.suppliers : [];
        return cached.find((s) => Number(s.id) === sid) || null;
      },

      updateModalLiveState() {
        const sup = this._activeSupplier;
        const tr = this._treasuryStatus || { hasOpenShift: false, sessionId: null, drawerExpectedCash: 0, vaultBalance: 0 };

        const debtValEl = document.getElementById('supPayCurrentDebtVal');
        const fillBtn = document.getElementById('supPayFillFullBtn');
        const amtInp = document.getElementById('supPayAmountInput');
        const advBox = document.getElementById('supPayAllowAdvanceBox');
        const advChk = document.getElementById('supPayAllowAdvanceChk');
        const srcSel = document.getElementById('supPayFundingSourceSelect');
        const methodSel = document.getElementById('supPayMethodSelect');
        const badge = document.getElementById('supPayShiftStatusBadge');
        const hintEl = document.getElementById('supPayFundingHint');
        const quickRow = document.getElementById('supPayQuickOpenShiftRow');
        const extBox = document.getElementById('supPayExternalPayerBox');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('supPaySubmitBtn');

        const debt = Number(Number((sup && sup.total_debt) || 0).toFixed(2));
        const enteredAmt = Number(amtInp ? amtInp.value : 0) || 0;
        const src = srcSel ? srcSel.value : 'active_shift';

        if (debtValEl) {
          if (debt > 0.009) {
            debtValEl.textContent = fmtDzd(debt);
            debtValEl.className = 'text-xl font-black font-mono text-rose-600 mt-0.5';
          } else if (debt < -0.009) {
            debtValEl.textContent = 'لنا تسبقة: ' + fmtDzd(Math.abs(debt));
            debtValEl.className = 'text-lg font-black font-mono text-emerald-600 mt-0.5';
          } else {
            debtValEl.textContent = '0.00 د.ج (الحساب خالص)';
            debtValEl.className = 'text-lg font-black font-mono text-emerald-600 mt-0.5';
          }
        }

        if (fillBtn) {
          fillBtn.style.display = debt > 0.009 ? '' : 'none';
          fillBtn.onclick = () => {
            if (amtInp) {
              amtInp.value = debt.toFixed(2);
              this.updateModalLiveState();
            }
          };
        }

        // إظهار خيار التسبقة تلقائياً إذا كان الدين 0 أو كان المبلغ المدخل أكبر من الدين
        const needsAdvance = debt <= 0.009 || enteredAmt > debt + 0.009;
        if (advBox) advBox.classList.toggle('hidden', !needsAdvance);
        if (!needsAdvance && advChk) advChk.checked = false;

        // تحديث شارة الوردية المفتوحة
        if (badge) {
          if (tr.hasOpenShift) {
            badge.textContent = '🟢 وردية #' + tr.sessionId + ' مفتوحة (' + fmtDzd(tr.drawerExpectedCash) + ')';
            badge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300';
          } else {
            badge.textContent = '🔴 لا توجد وردية مفتوحة';
            badge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-600';
          }
        }

        // إظهار حقل الدافع الخارجي عند اختيار مال خارجي
        if (extBox) extBox.classList.toggle('hidden', src !== 'external_owner');
        if (quickRow) quickRow.classList.toggle('hidden', !(src === 'active_shift' && !tr.hasOpenShift));

        // المزامنة الذكية بين مصدر المال وطريقة الدفع
        if (methodSel && src === 'bank_ccp' && methodSel.value === 'cash') {
          methodSel.value = 'cib';
        }

        // تحديث الشرح والتنبيهات الفورية
        let blockReason = '';
        let warnMsg = '';

        if (src === 'active_shift') {
          if (!tr.hasOpenShift) {
            blockReason = '⛔ لا يمكن الخصم من درج الوردية لأن الوردية مغلقة حالياً — افتح وردية جديدة أو اختر "الخزينة الرئيسية" أو "مال خارجي / المالك".';
          } else if (enteredAmt > tr.drawerExpectedCash + 0.009) {
            warnMsg = '⚠️ تنبيه سيولة: المبلغ (' + fmtDzd(enteredAmt) + ') يتجاوز السيولة المتوقعة في الدرج (' + fmtDzd(tr.drawerExpectedCash) + '). يفضّل الدفع من الخزينة الرئيسية أو مال خارجي حتى لا يصبح الدرج سالباً.';
          }
          if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = tr.hasOpenShift
            ? 'سيُخصم المبلغ مباشرةً من درج الوردية #' + tr.sessionId + ' ويظهر في تقرير Z-Report ضمن الأموال الخارجة.'
            : 'الوردية مغلقة — اختر مصدراً خارجياً أو افتح وردية.';
        } else if (src === 'shop_vault') {
          if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = 'سيُخصم من الخزينة الرئيسية (الرصيد التقديري: ' + fmtDzd(tr.vaultBalance) + ') دون المساس بدرج الكاشير.';
        } else if (src === 'bank_ccp') {
          if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = 'تسديد بنكي / بريدي موب / شيك — لا يؤثر على الكاش النقدي داخل درج الكاشير.';
        } else if (src === 'external_owner') {
          if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = 'تمويل خارجي من المالك أو طرف خارجي — يعمل حتى بدون وردية ولا ينقص درج الكاشير، ويُذكر في تقرير نهاية الوردية.';
        }

        if (!blockReason && debt <= 0.009 && !(advChk && advChk.checked)) {
          warnMsg = 'ℹ️ هذا المورد ليس له دين مستحق حالياً (0.00 د.ج). فعّل مربع "تسبقة / Avance" أعلاه إن أردت الدفع له مقدماً.';
        }

        if (blockReason) showInlineAlert(blockReason, 'error');
        else if (warnMsg) showInlineAlert(warnMsg, 'warning');
        else showInlineAlert('', '');

        if (submitBtn) {
          const isBlocked = Boolean(blockReason) || (debt <= 0.009 && !(advChk && advChk.checked));
          submitBtn.disabled = isBlocked;
          submitBtn.style.opacity = isBlocked ? '0.55' : '1';
          submitBtn.style.cursor = isBlocked ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer';
          submitBtn.textContent = (advChk && advChk.checked)

        }
      },

      async hydrateSupplierPaymentModal(supplierIdOverride) {

      async submitSupplierPaymentSafe(shouldPrint = true) {
        const sid = Number(document.getElementById('supPaySupplierId')?.value || 0);
        const amt = Number(document.getElementById('supPayAmountInput')?.value || 0);
        const method = document.getElementById('supPayMethodSelect')?.value || 'cash';
        const notes = String(document.getElementById('supPayNotesInput')?.value || '').trim();
        const fundingSource = document.getElementById('supPayFundingSourceSelect')?.value || 'active_shift';
        const externalPayer = String(document.getElementById('supPayExternalPayerInput')?.value || '').trim();
        const allowAdvance = Boolean(document.getElementById('supPayAllowAdvanceChk')?.checked);

        if (!sid) {
          showInlineAlert('لم يتم تحديد المورد.', 'error');
          return { success: false };
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(amt) || amt <= 0.009) {
          showInlineAlert('يرجى إدخال مبلغ صحيح أكبر من الصفر.', 'error');
          return { success: false };
        }

        const tr = await this.loadTreasuryStatus();
        if (fundingSource === 'active_shift' && !tr.hasOpenShift) {
          showInlineAlert('⛔ الوردية مغلقة حالياً — افتح وردية أو غيّر مصدر الدفع إلى "الخزينة الرئيسية" أو "مال خارجي".', 'error');
          return { success: false };
        }

        try {
          const res = await window.api.addSupplierPayment(sid, amt, new Date().toISOString(), {
            payment_method: method,
            notes,
            funding_source: fundingSource,
            external_payer: externalPayer,
            allow_advance: allowAdvance,
            userId: window.AppState?.currentUser?.id || null
          });

          if (!res || res.success === false) {
            const errMsg = (res && res.message) || 'تعذر إتمام عملية التسديد للمورد.';
            showInlineAlert(errMsg, 'error');
            if (window.App && typeof window.App.showToast === 'function') {
              window.App.showToast(errMsg, 'error');
            }
            return res || { success: false };
          }

          if (window.App && typeof window.App.closeModal === 'function') {
            window.App.closeModal('supplierPaymentModal');
          }

          // إبطال الكاش وتحديث صفحة الموردين والصندوق فوراً
          if (window.GherbiStage4Turbo) window.GherbiStage4Turbo.invalidate('all');
          if (window.GherbiStage5Ops) window.GherbiStage5Ops.invalidate('all');
          if (window.App && typeof window.App.loadSuppliersView === 'function') {
            await window.App.loadSuppliersView().catch(() => {});
          } else if (window.GherbiSuppliersTurbo && typeof window.GherbiSuppliersTurbo.render === 'function') {
            await window.GherbiSuppliersTurbo.render(true).catch(() => {});
          }

          if (window.App && typeof window.App.showToast === 'function') {
            const label = res.isAdvance ? 'تم تسجيل تسبقة للمورد' : 'تم تسديد دفعة للمورد';
            window.App.showToast('✅ ' + label + ' (' + fmtDzd(res.appliedAmount || amt) + ') — ' + (res.fundingLabel || ''), 'success');
          }

          // طباعة وصل المورد المعتمد من مركز الطباعة (supplier_payment_receipt)
          if (shouldPrint && window.GherbiPrintStudioPro && window.GherbiPrintStudioPro.router) {
            const sup = this._activeSupplier || { name: res.supplierName || ('المورد #' + sid), phone: '' };
            const docData = {
              docNumber: res.receiptNumber || ('REC-SUP-' + (res.paymentId || '')),
              date: new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16),
              isWalkinCustomer: false,
              partyTitle: 'المورد / المستفيد:',
              partyName: sup.name || res.supplierName || ('المورد #' + sid),
              partyPhone: sup.phone || '',
              paymentMethod: (res.fundingLabel || '') + ' (' + method + ')',
              cashierName: window.AppState?.currentUser?.name || 'المدير العام',
              items: [{
                barcode: res.isAdvance ? 'ADV' : 'PAY',
                name: (res.isAdvance ? 'تسبقة مسبقة للمورد (Avance)' : 'دفعة تسديد حساب المورد') + (notes ? (' — ' + notes) : ''),
                unit: 'دفعة',
                qty: 1,
                price: res.appliedAmount || amt,
                subtotal: res.appliedAmount || amt
              }],
              subtotal: res.appliedAmount || amt,
              discount: 0,
              total: res.appliedAmount || amt,
              paidAmount: res.appliedAmount || amt,
              receivedAmount: res.appliedAmount || amt,
              remainingDebt: Math.max(0, Number(res.remainingDebtAfter || 0))
            };
            await window.GherbiPrintStudioPro.router.printDocumentByType('supplier_payment_receipt', docData, { silent: false }).catch(() => {});
          }

          return res;
        } catch (err) {
          const cleanMsg = String((err && err.message) || err || 'خطأ غير متوقع').replace(/^Error invoking remote method[^:]+:\s*Error:\s*/i, '');
          showInlineAlert(cleanMsg, 'error');
          if (window.App && typeof window.App.showToast === 'function') {
            window.App.showToast('❌ ' + cleanMsg, 'error');
          }
          return { success: false, error: cleanMsg };
        }
      },

      // تحسين أزرار جدول إدارة الموردين: تمييز المورد الخالص (0.00 د.ج) عن المورد المدين بوضوح بصري فوري
      enhanceSuppliersTableButtons() {
        const view = document.getElementById('view-suppliers');
        if (!view) return;
        const rows = view.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
        rows.forEach((tr) => {
          const txt = tr.textContent || '';
          const payBtn = Array.from(tr.querySelectorAll('button')).find((b) => /تسديد/.test(b.textContent || '') && !b.dataset.s6aStyled);
          if (!payBtn) return;

          // فحص ما إذا كان عمود الدين المتبقي للمورد يساوي 0.00 د.ج
          const cells = Array.from(tr.querySelectorAll('td'));
          const debtCell = cells.find((td) => /0\.00\s*د\.ج/.test(td.textContent || '') && !/مشتريات/.test(td.textContent || ''));
          const hasZeroDebt = Boolean(debtCell && /\b0\.00\s*د\.ج/.test((debtCell.textContent || '').trim()));

          payBtn.dataset.s6aStyled = '1';
          if (hasZeroDebt) {
            payBtn.innerHTML = '✅ خالص <span style="opacity:0.8;font-size:10px;">(تسبقة)</span>';
            payBtn.title = 'لا يوجد دين مستحق — اضغط فقط إذا أردت تسجيل تسبقة (Avance) لهذا المورد';
            payBtn.style.background = '#e2e8f0';
            payBtn.style.color = '#334155';
            payBtn.style.border = '1px solid #cbd5e1';
          }
        });
      },

      installHooks() {
        const app = window.App;
        if (!app || app._s6aSuppliersHooked) return false;
        app._s6aSuppliersHooked = true;
        const self = this;

        // 1. تغليف فتح نافذة تسديد المورد لجلب الدين الحي وحالة الوردية فوراً
        if (typeof app.openSupplierPaymentModal === 'function') {
          const origOpen = app.openSupplierPaymentModal.bind(app);
          app.openSupplierPaymentModal = async function s6aOpenSupPay(supId, ...rest) {
            const out = await origOpen(supId, ...rest);
            await self.hydrateSupplierPaymentModal(supId);
            return out;
          };
        }

        // 2. استبدال دالة الحفظ بدالتنا المحصّنة ذات الـ 4 مصادر والتعامل الآمن مع الأخطاء
        app.submitSupplierPaymentModal = function s6aSubmitSupPay(shouldPrint = true) {
          return self.submitSupplierPaymentSafe(shouldPrint);
        };

        // 3. مراقب خفيف على #supplierPaymentModal و #view-suppliers (يغطي أي فتح مباشر عبر GherbiSuppliersTurbo)
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
          const modal = document.getElementById('supplierPaymentModal');
          if (modal && !modal._s6aObs) {
            modal._s6aObs = true;
            const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
              if (modal.classList.contains('active') || modal.style.display === 'flex') {
                setTimeout(() => self.hydrateSupplierPaymentModal(), 40);
              }
            });
            obs.observe(modal, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style'] });
          }

          const supView = document.getElementById('view-suppliers');
          if (supView && !supView._s6aTableObs) {
            supView._s6aTableObs = true;
            let t = null;
            const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
              clearTimeout(t);
              t = setTimeout(() => self.enhanceSuppliersTableButtons(), 60);
            });
            obs.observe(supView, { childList: true, subtree: true });
          }
        }

        return true;
      },

      boot() {
        this.bindModalControls();
        this.installHooks();
        let tries = 0;
        const iv = setInterval(() => {
          tries++;
          if (this.installHooks() || tries >= 40) clearInterval(iv);
        }, 120);
        console.log('🛡️ [WAR STAGE 6A]: محرك مصادر التمويل الأربعة وإدارة الموردين الذكية جاهز 100% (GherbiTreasuryStage6A).');
      }
    };

    window.GherbiTreasuryStage6A = Stage6A;
    Stage6A.boot();
  })();
})();

/* === [WAR STAGE 6B-PART1: VISIBLE SUPPLIER ADVANCES & 100% ROW SYNC] === */
(function installStage6ASupplierAdvancesTableUpgraderV2() {
  'use strict';

  function fmtNum(v) {
    return Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + ' د.ج';
  }

  function patchStage6A() {
    const s6a = window.GherbiTreasuryStage6A;
    if (!s6a || s6a._advancesUiUpgradedV2) return false;
    s6a._advancesUiUpgradedV2 = true;
    s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter = false;
    s6a._lastSupRefreshTs = 0;

    function extractSupIdFromRow(tr) {
      if (tr && tr.dataset) {
        const did = Number(tr.dataset.supplierId || tr.dataset.supId || tr.dataset.id || 0);
        if (did > 0) return did;
      }
      const html = (tr && tr.innerHTML) || '';
      const m = html.match(/(?:openSupplierPaymentModal|openSupplierLedger|editSupplier|deleteSupplier|paySupplier)\s*\(\s*(\d+)/);
      return m && m[1] ? Number(m[1]) : 0;
    }

    s6a.enhanceSuppliersTableButtons = function enhanceSuppliersTableWithAdvancesV2() {
      const view = document.getElementById('view-suppliers');
      if (!view) return;

      const list = (window.AppState && Array.isArray(window.AppState.suppliers)) ? window.AppState.suppliers : [];

      // جلب صامت لمرة واحدة كل 1.5 ثانية إذا كانت القائمة فارغة أو لا تحتوي على advance_balance
      const now = Date.now();
      if (
        (list.length === 0 || (list[0] && list[0].advance_balance === undefined)) &&
        window.api &&
        typeof window.api.getSuppliers === 'function' &&
        now - (s6a._lastSupRefreshTs || 0) > 1500
      ) {
        s6a._lastSupRefreshTs = now;
        window.api.getSuppliers().then((fresh) => {
          if (Array.isArray(fresh) && window.AppState) {
            window.AppState.suppliers = fresh;
            s6a.enhanceSuppliersTableButtons();
          }
        }).catch(() => {});
      }

      if (list.length === 0) return;

      const byId = new Map();
      const byName = new Map();
      let totalAdvancesSum = 0;
      let advancesCount = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const s = list[i];
        if (!s) continue;
        byId.set(Number(s.id), s);
        byName.set(String(s.name || '').trim().toLowerCase(), s);
        const signed = Number(s.total_debt || 0);
        const adv = signed < -0.009 ? Math.abs(signed) : Number(s.advance_balance || 0);
        if (adv > 0.009) {
          totalAdvancesSum += adv;
          advancesCount++;
        }
      }
      totalAdvancesSum = Number(totalAdvancesSum.toFixed(2));

      // تحديد عمود "الدين المتبقي للمورد" بدقة من ترويسة الجدول
      let debtColIdx = -1;
      const ths = Array.from(view.querySelectorAll('thead th'));
      for (let i = 0; i < ths.length; i++) {
        if (/الدين المتبقي|المتبقي للمورد/i.test(ths[i].textContent || '')) {
          debtColIdx = i;
          break;
        }
      }

      const rows = Array.from(view.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'));
      rows.forEach((tr) => {
        const tds = Array.from(tr.querySelectorAll('td'));
        if (tds.length < 2) return;

        let sup = null;
        const rowId = extractSupIdFromRow(tr);
        if (rowId && byId.has(rowId)) {
          sup = byId.get(rowId);
        } else {
          const lines = String((tds[0] && tds[0].textContent) || '').split(/\r?\n/).map((x) => x.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
          for (let j = 0; j < lines.length; j++) {
            if (byName.has(lines[j])) {
              sup = byName.get(lines[j]);
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (!sup) return;

        const signed = Number(Number(sup.total_debt || 0).toFixed(2));
        const advAmt = signed < -0.009 ? Number(Math.abs(signed).toFixed(2)) : Number(Number(sup.advance_balance || 0).toFixed(2));
        const debtDue = signed > 0.009 ? signed : 0;

        if (s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter) {
          tr.style.display = advAmt > 0.009 ? '' : 'none';
        }

        // أ) عرض شارة التسبقة خارجياً أمام عمود الدين المتبقي للمورد
        const targetDebtTd = debtColIdx >= 0 && tds[debtColIdx] ? tds[debtColIdx] : null;
        if (targetDebtTd) {
          const expectedKey = debtDue.toFixed(2) + ':' + advAmt.toFixed(2);
          if (targetDebtTd.dataset.s6bDebtKey !== expectedKey) {
            targetDebtTd.dataset.s6bDebtKey = expectedKey;
            if (advAmt > 0.009) {
              targetDebtTd.innerHTML =
                '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px;">' +
                  '<span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:900;color:#059669;font-size:11px;">0.00 د.ج</span>' +
                  '<span data-s6b-advance-badge="1" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0284c7,#2563eb);color:#ffffff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(37,99,235,0.25);">' +
                    '💎 تسبقة لنا: ' + fmtNum(advAmt) +
                  '</span>' +
                '</div>';
            } else if (debtDue <= 0.009) {
              targetDebtTd.innerHTML =
                '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;">' +
                  '<span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:900;color:#059669;">0.00 د.ج</span>' +
                  '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#047857;background:#ecfdf5;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:999px;">خالص</span>' +
                '</div>';
            }
          }
        }

        // ب) توحيد زر الإجراء على 100% من الصفوف
        const payBtn = Array.from(tr.querySelectorAll('button')).find((b) => {
          const txt = b.textContent || '';
          const oc = (typeof b.getAttribute === 'function' ? b.getAttribute('onclick') : '') || '';
          return /openSupplierPaymentModal/.test(oc) || /تسديد|خالص|تسبقة/.test(txt);
        });
        if (payBtn) {
          const btnKey = debtDue > 0.009 ? 'debt' : advAmt > 0.009 ? 'adv' : 'clean';
          if (payBtn.dataset.s6bBtnKey !== btnKey) {
            payBtn.dataset.s6bBtnKey = btnKey;
            if (btnKey === 'adv') {
              payBtn.innerHTML = '💎 + تسبقة';
              payBtn.title = 'لدينا تسبقة (' + fmtNum(advAmt) + ') — اضغط لإضافة تسبقة جديدة';
              payBtn.style.background = '#e0f2fe';
              payBtn.style.color = '#0369a1';
              payBtn.style.border = '1px solid #7dd3fc';
            } else if (btnKey === 'clean') {
              payBtn.innerHTML = '✅ خالص <span style="opacity:0.8;font-size:10px;">(تسبقة)</span>';
              payBtn.title = 'لا يوجد دين مستحق — اضغط فقط إذا أردت تسجيل تسبقة (Avance) لهذا المورد';
              payBtn.style.background = '#e2e8f0';
              payBtn.style.color = '#334155';
              payBtn.style.border = '1px solid #cbd5e1';
            } else {
              payBtn.innerHTML = '💵 تسديد';
              payBtn.style.background = '';
              payBtn.style.color = '';
              payBtn.style.border = '';
            }
          }
        }
      });

      // سطر إجمالي التسبقات داخل البطاقة العلوية الحمراء
      const allCards = Array.from(view.querySelectorAll('div')).filter((d) => {
        const t = d.textContent || '';
        return t.includes('إجمالي الديون المستحقة للموردين') && d.querySelectorAll('div').length < 10;
      });
      const debtKpiCard = allCards[allCards.length - 1];
      if (debtKpiCard) {
        let advPill = debtKpiCard.querySelector('#s6bSupTotalAdvancesPill');
        if (totalAdvancesSum > 0.009) {
          if (!advPill) {
            advPill = document.createElement('div');
            advPill.id = 's6bSupTotalAdvancesPill';
            advPill.style.cssText = 'margin-top:6px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.45);color:#ffffff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;';
            debtKpiCard.appendChild(advPill);
          }
          advPill.textContent = '💎 تسبقات لنا عند الموردين: ' + fmtNum(totalAdvancesSum) + ' (' + advancesCount + ')';
        } else if (advPill) {
          advPill.remove();
        }
      }

      // زر فلتر "💎 لديهم تسبقة (N)"
      const cleanFilterBtn = Array.from(view.querySelectorAll('button')).find((b) => /حسابهم خالص/.test(b.textContent || ''));
      if (cleanFilterBtn && cleanFilterBtn.parentNode) {
        let advFilterBtn = view.querySelector('#s6bSupAdvancesFilterBtn');
        if (!advFilterBtn) {
          advFilterBtn = document.createElement('button');
          advFilterBtn.id = 's6bSupAdvancesFilterBtn';
          advFilterBtn.type = 'button';
          advFilterBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;border:1.5px solid #38bdf8;background:#e0f2fe;color:#0369a1;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;';
          advFilterBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter = !s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter;
            advFilterBtn.style.background = s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter ? '#0284c7' : '#e0f2fe';
            advFilterBtn.style.color = s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter ? '#ffffff' : '#0369a1';
            const rowsNow = Array.from(view.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'));
            if (!s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter) rowsNow.forEach((r) => { r.style.display = ''; });
            s6a.enhanceSuppliersTableButtons();
          });
          cleanFilterBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(advFilterBtn, cleanFilterBtn.nextSibling);

          Array.from(cleanFilterBtn.parentNode.querySelectorAll('button')).forEach((ob) => {
            if (ob.id === 's6bSupAdvancesFilterBtn' || ob.dataset.s6bResetWired) return;
            ob.dataset.s6bResetWired = '1';
            ob.addEventListener('click', () => {
              s6a._onlyAdvancesFilter = false;
              advFilterBtn.style.background = '#e0f2fe';
              advFilterBtn.style.color = '#0369a1';
            });
          });
        }
        advFilterBtn.textContent = '💎 لديهم تسبقة (' + advancesCount + ')';
      }
    };

    setTimeout(() => s6a.enhanceSuppliersTableButtons(), 120);
    return true;
  }

  if (!patchStage6A()) {
    let k = 0;
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      k++;
      if (patchStage6A() || k >= 30) clearInterval(iv);
    }, 100);
  }
})();

/**
 * perf-core/treasury-stage6b-expenses-purchases-workers.js
